ln:4464966227.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join JPMorgan, where you will have the opportunity to make real innovative impacts to our customers and be part of a dynamic environment where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

As a Transactions Analyst within JPMorganChase, you will have a direct impact on our team and department, ensuring smooth and efficient transaction processes. You will leverage your knowledge of transaction management to identify and resolve issues, guided by established practices and procedures. Your role will involve providing management with data and analytics to assist with targeted coaching and mentoring of Specialists and enhancing customer experience. You will also be expected to think strategically, fostering innovation and team building. Your proficiency in artificial intelligence and automation will be crucial in optimizing our transaction processes. Furthermore, your ability to interpret and communicate data will help us make informed decisions that drive impact. Your role is essential in maintaining our commitment to providing top-notch service to our customers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with Client Service and remote locations for trade finance products (including Supply Chain Financing, Guarantee/SBLC, BAD Discounting, Trade Loan) booking
  • Strictly follow Standard Operation Procedure to ensure the processing of all trade transactions are in compliance with law, ICC Rules, regulations, JPM's policy and Services Standard of the Division
  • Investigate and answer inquiries from both internal and external clients, and maintain proper record
  • Timely escalate for any issues with potential risk or loss
  • Assist operation manager in dealing with external & internal affairs and participate in relevant projects and other ad hoc events as required
  • Produce regulatory report
  • Utilize artificial intelligence and automation technologies to optimize transaction processes and improve efficiency

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • College graduate or above
  • Minimum 2-3 years of Trade Finance working experience at foreign bank
  • Solid understanding of relevant PBOC/NFRA/SAFE regulation
  • Knowledge on URDG, AML and OFAC regulations
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin
  • Able to handle multiple tasks at the same time
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize artificial intelligence and automation technologies to optimize processes and improve efficiency

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：59333

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead Technical Direction & Trading Architecture: Own the technical vision, architectural roadmap, and execution strategy for Core OMS, EMS and multi-couterparties connectivity, in close partnership with Product Owners, Market Operations, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams.
  • Hands-on Technical Leadership: Lead by example through hands-on system design, low-latency coding, rigorous code reviews, different protocols integration, performance profiling, and troubleshooting complex production issues.
  • Scalable & Resilient Trading Systems: Design and deliver high-throughput, fault-tolerant, and zero-loss microservices, event-driven messaging, caching layers, pre-trade risk controls, and automated reconciliation engines.
  • AI & Agentic SDLC Transformation: Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows across requirements decomposition, automated test generation (contract testing), code generation, automated code reviews, and release readiness.
  • Engineering Standards & Guardrails: Establish best-in-class engineering standards covering automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, observability (Geneos, AppDynamics, Splunk), and automated pre-trade risk/compliance guardrails.
  • End-to-End Delivery Ownership: Drive execution from concept to production rollout, managing technical debt, architectural runway, dependencies, and regulatory commitments across multi-region deployments.
  • People & Culture Development: Coach, mentor, and grow software engineers; cultivate an engineering culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, ownership, and innovation.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Deep Hands-on Engineering Expertise: Substantial experience designing, building, and operating high-volume, low-latency, mission-critical distributed systems using modern Java, Spring Boot or Python
  • Capital Markets & Trading Domain Knowledge: Proven understanding of order management lifecycles, Smart Order Routing, market data processing, pre-trade risk controls, and post-trade reconciliation.
  • Proven Technical Leadership: Demonstrated track record of setting technical direction, leading complex multi-tier system deliveries, and guiding distributed engineering teams within global organizations.
  • Distributed & Event-Driven Systems:Deep practical experience with event-driven architecture (Apache Kafka / JMS), caching strategies (Redis), relational databases (PostgreSQL / Oracle), resilient API designs (REST / gRPC), and distributed transaction management.
  • AI-Enabled Engineering & Emerging Tech Practical experience leveraging AI-enabled development tools and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AWS Bedrock, LLM tooling, automated test generation) to measurably boost SDLC efficiency, quality, and velocity.
  • Resilience, Concurrency & High Availability: Strong expertise in designing for fault tolerance, failover/contingency patterns, idempotency, rate-limiting, circuit breaking, and sub-millisecond/low-latency optimization.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Communication: Ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into incremental technical milestones and articulate technical trade-offs to senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent written and spoken English.

ln:4463801981.descriptionHtml:
Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Impact on the Business/Function

  • Coordinate the execution of the Outbound strategy, including strategy paper, initiatives formulation, driving actions and track the deliverables.
  • Drive the in-country execution of the Group's Outbound strategy to drive revenue and achieve the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets.
  • Support customer account strategies and liaise with Regions/Branches assigning prospects and opportunities to HBCN Coverage Bankers / Global Network Banking (GNB) RMs.
  • Develop metrics and reporting mechanisms that monitor execution of the Outbound strategy.
  • Interpret and communicate any global GNB and regulatory developments and ensure timely training and familiarization for frontline teams is delivered.
  • Execute tactical projects to ensure that market firsts are attained for key products and market trends.
  • Devise strategy to raise Outbound and international awareness/knowledge for front-line colleagues.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Build relationships with government officials, trade bodies, commercial chambers and regulators in China. Focus on capturing ODI opportunities.
  • Participate in meetings with major/high level Outbound clients and prospects, to provide guidance, pitch for new business, resolve any issues, and facilitate smooth operations and services, thus building loyalty and client satisfaction.
  • Establish the agenda for internal education (e.g. workshops and seminars) and external marketing (client forums and summits).
  • Deepen customer relationships through championing business co-operation with key stakeholders including Global Business, Global Products and Global Functions, to contribute to Outbound strategy.
  • Provide 'thought leadership' on Outbound matters to key internal stakeholders and serve as a subject matter expertise on international.
  • Organize and execute workshops, forums, seminars, roadshows and presentations.
  • Work with in-country stakeholders where required to remove any blockages for transactions and coordinate escalation to resolve matters in a timely and efficient manner.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Work closely with Global Businesses, Global Products and Global Functions to execute a comprehensive strategy for the China Outbound proposition.
  • Build network with Group offices (including global CIB, GNB and China Desks) to enhance profile and cooperation with China.
  • Manage China Desk Manager (CDM) proposition/governance and support periodical review on CDM structure to align with China CIB and GNB management. Coordinate feedback to GNB teams on CDM performance and provide support on people management matters.

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • Continually assess operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructuring and the impact of new technology.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Essential

  • Proven and progressive business development, sales management, and credit experience or equivalent.
  • Adaptability and mobility. The role may require the jobholder to frequently travel throughout China and work abroad on short term assignments.
  • Extensive knowledge and proven sales success with the Bank's products and services, or equivalent
  • Good understanding and knowledge of GNB and experience with working with multinational corporates.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills including organizational, analytical, negotiation, communication, teamwork and influencing skills.
  • Ability to set and manage own agenda, while ensuring alignment with stakeholder priorities.
  • Excellent spoken and written Mandarin and English.

Desired

  • University graduate degree in business related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Understanding of local operating markets and their corresponding span(s) of control within assigned region.
  • Experience of driving strategic change in a matrix environment.

Group Leadership Capabilities - the following capabilities have been identified as essential for this role:

  • Navigating - Anticipating future needs of stakeholders, reconciling opposing stakeholder needs, ensuring the vision is understood by all stakeholders and translating Group Strategy into immediate business/function.
  • Aspiring - Knowledge of standards in leading global organizations, driving performance against leading global standards, competing successfully and actively improving capability.
  • Driving - Enabling others to take the lead, courageously taking on stretching challenges, thriving under pressure, seeking opportunities to transform immediate business/function and set stretching goals.
  • Mobilizing - Inspiring relevant stakeholders, championing diversity and inclusion within immediate business/function, fully leveraging the matrix, maximizing employee engagement, creating a high-performance culture, optimizing the pace of delivery.
  • Sustaining - Championing respect and fairness in dealings with others, enhancing the brand of HSBC, and championing HSBC Values and Culture.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment.   • Align ALM strategic development directions along Business Strategy, Product, Investment, Actuarial, Finance and Risks functions at INSH and with Group

  • Qualified actuary with senior experience in life insurance companies or consultancy firms under a similar role

  • Knowledge in IFRS17 reporting, CROSS II is required. Knowledge in Hong Kong or Singapore local regulatory solvency requirement is an asset

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable backend systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes

Skills And Experience

  • Java (Spring Boot)
  • Relational DB
  • MQ
  • Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
  • Design Pattern
  • API

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • 3-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
  • Experience working in agile development environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous

Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of performance optimization and system scalability techniques
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

About Standard Chartered

You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People and Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 10+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design & Architecture

Job Summary

Account for branch’s operations; counter transactions including system operations to ensure execution accuracy, compliance, and completeness in line with bank internal and external rules/procedures/manuals/standards/group requirements/regulatory requirement/laws as well as to keep high class level of services to our clients.

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验。

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Key Responsibilities/Challenges 主要工作职责/挑战

  • General 总则
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Business

  • Support to achieve business objective at the respective branch
  • Drive or support cost optimization initiatives to achieve cost saving target
  • 协助分支行实现工作目标
  • 主动倡议或协助银行推进各项成本优化创新方案的实现

Processes

  • Service 客户服务质量
  • Embed client centric mind in daily operation as well as to maintain up best in class front-line service
  • Continue to advocate human banker and client centric service mindset in service staff for enriching internal and external customer experience
  • Achieve client satisfaction in daily branch services and operations
  • Build SCB a great place to work
  • 在日常工作中始终倡导“以客户为中心”的服务理念，给客户提供最优质的服务
  • 在服务中始终秉承“以人为本，以客户为中心”的服务理念，保持并提升内外部客户的服务体验
  • 在分支行日常对外服务中，始终以客户满意为服务宗旨
  • 始终立志于共同将渣打银行构建成一个员工和客户都喜欢的公司

Risk Management

  • Operations, Conduct and Risk Control 营运操作，行为规范和风险控制
  • Handle all counter operations, branch transactions in good result to ensure all bank internal and external rules/standards/procedures/manual are strictly followed
  • Perform bank required due diligence in branch start of day and end of day work on daily base to ensure no exception in execution
  • Complete regulatory required reporting timely and accurately to ensure the report follows regulatory requirements with no exception
  • Support Line Manager achieve good MCA rating in branch audit
  • Escalate for any exception detected or observed in daily work to minimize potential negative impact on the bank
  • Ensure all required certifications are obtained per internal and external requirements
  • Acknowledge and follow bank job rotation policy/procedure that working location will be subject to detail arrangement on due with no objection
  • Adhere to bank Conduct Plan, and all control and assurance mechanisms to comply with all internal and external standards and policies in executions
  • Adhere to laws and regulations, internal risk (including FCC risks as anti-money laundry, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption), compliance policies and the Group Code of Conduct; well manage client complaints & CDD
  • 负责分支行交易（含柜台业务）的办理及系统操作，确保执行结果完全符合银行内外部各项规定、准则、集团政策，操作手册/规定、外部法规及法律等
  • 严格遵守银行在分支行营运起始、营运中、营运日终的各项业务开展及审核的尽职要求，确保营运工作没有纰漏及差错
  • 认真履行监管报表的报送，确保报送内容、报送时间均符合监管及银行内部操作要求，没有差错或纰漏
  • 协助主管在银行内部审计中取得良好的MCA (management control approach)成绩
  • 及时汇报或发现任何异常的操作现象或问题确保营运风险最低化
  • 根据银行的内外部要求，确保获得岗位就职需要的各项有效证书

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Work in PCVC team to manage the Product control activities for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Support Team Head to establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

Skills and Experience

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness
  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
  • CICPA & CFA is preferred
  • Languages: Chinese and English

Job Description

Job Summary

The role holder will spearhead the stressed and distressed loan trading strategy of the Loan Trading, East desk within Credit Trading. This person will be responsible for making sure that proper risk analyses are done prior to risk proposals, and that relevant risk approvals are in place. Therefore, the role holder will need to be highly experienced and skilled/proven across all aspects of stressed and distressed loan trading to be convincingly effective in conveying clear, accurate ideas and the correct risk picture in securing relevant approvals and limits. In summary, the role holder will diligently manage a risk book designed to book stressed / distressed loans and secondarily trade par loans opportunistically with profitable churn within ageing limits.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To grow meaningfully the secondary trading franchise of fixed income assets – IG, HY & Financials of issuers in Greater China (“China Credit”) for Global Credit Trading.
  • Work with Sales, e-Sales, e-Trading, Research, Capital Markets, Technology and Syndication to execute initiatives to grow the broader Global Credit franchise.
  • Awareness and understanding of the strategy and business model of the larger Trading Group and Global Credit, as appropriate to the role.
  • Ensuring effective end to end client identification, risk management, service and infrastructure.
  • Work in conjunction with other partners to ensure SCB has a best-in-class offering for the EM credit asset class especially China Local Currency Credit.
  • Assistant in sending market colour / comments to sales on daily basis and promoting China onshore flow business.
  • Providing timely updated credit analysis/ profiles on China credit names for trading desk and to sales
  • Facilitate smooth deal execution including deal detail check and help to centralize booking instruction when necessary.
  • Helping sales translate specific clients’ needs into specific bonds.
  • Deliver training and education on products to internal and external audiences (sales and clients)
  • Ensure the stability, long-term sustainability, and reputation of the Bank.
  • Identifying areas of concern on matters of appropriateness/suitability and raising them to senior team members.
  • Provide timely support on credit bonds both at the trade idea origination level and at execution time
  • Generate/providing market watch and generic trade ideas to sales force, provide support on documentation review and drafting, deliver marketing support and product explanation to sales and to clients when necessary.
  • Analysing, assessing and propose specific credit bonds based on specific client needs, liaise with sales/trading/legal/MO and other related support functions to transform idea to trade.

Business

  • Increase SCB’s visibility by driving commercial, competitive pricing of credit trading for our clients.
  • Help manage the implementation of flow credit trading specific strategies and ensure that performance objectives and revenue goals are met and RWA targets managed.
  • Active performance monitoring – spot areas of underperformance and take corrective action.

Processes

  • Ensure adherence to all internal and external regulations.
  • To embed Operational Risk monitoring as an integral part of the business process. Towards this, to effectively carry out the assigned role, if any, under Compliance Risk Management and Operational Risk Management Assurance.
  • Ensure that the business meets its obligations the prevention of money laundering under the Group Policy and Standards and under local laws and regulations.
  • Help ensure that there are appropriate and documented internal controls and procedures in place. Help monitor the operation of such procedures and controls and regularly review them to ensure that they reflect any changes in products, systems, policy and regulations.

People & Talent

  • Build a transparent and collaborative culture in which incentives are based on support of Client Income with specific performance metrics on the Bank’s values.
  • To work in partnership with Credit Flow teams across to ensure that the flow trading product is value additive for clients and the bank.

Risk Management

  • Identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Embed operational risk management and reporting as an integral part of the business process.
  • Ensure that adequate and appropriate systems and controls are in place to comply with Group and Business policies, procedures, standards, and codes.
  • Monitor all major risk issues and concentrations. Where appropriate, direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to Risk Committees.
  • Comply with guidelines as outlined in the annual Trader Mandate.

Governance

  • Promote an environment where compliance with internal control functions and external regulatory framework is a central priority of the business.
  • Establish, maintain, and supervise the framework to ensure business functions under my area of responsibility comply with internal policies, procedures, codes and applicable external laws and regulations and adhere to the expected high standards set out in the FM Code of Conduct.
  • Ensure the overall targets relating to budget are cascaded to teams with appropriate product targets and performance delivery on targets is proactively managed.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Adhere to any applicable regulators prescribed responsibilities.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • Credit Flow Sales, e-Sales
  • Credit Research, Syndication, Capital Markets
  • Credit Solutions and other teams in Credit Trading
  • Support and Control functions
  • Modelling and Analytics Group

External

  • As and when necessary

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CIB Markets; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

Skills and Experience

  • In-depth knowledge of the distressed credit landscape in APAC, covering illiquid, stressed/distressed debt, and special situations
  • Trading & analysis experience across a wide spectrum of loans: in varying credit rating qualities, structures, tenor, jurisdictions, and industries over many years
  • Track record of risk managing loan assets, including stressed/distressed, and distributing risk
  • Sharp business acumen, including ability to assess risk and commensurate level of RoRWA / RoTE

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in top universities in related majors
  • Strong interest in credit trading/sales business
  • Strong mathematical and numerical skills
  • Proficiency in data collection and analysis
  • Excellent research and writing abilities
  • Thorough understanding of credit market and financial analysis
  • Interpersonal skills and the ability to work under pressure
  • A team player who can work independently
  • [CFETS] Interbank Market CNY Product Trading License
  • [CFTC & National Futures Association & SEC] Authorized Associated Person Registration - SEC AAP registered.
  • [SEC] 15a-6 registered.

任职要求

Job Summary

  • Handle WRB HK MOX Credit Card process

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

To meet objectives set by the Group, Company & Department through:

  • Consistent high-quality performance in work with emphasis on accuracy, TAT & productivity.
  • Consistent high-quality service to customers (outside & within).
  • To contribute to the greater increase in efficiency and the effectiveness of WRB HK MOX Credit Card.

Processes

  • Perform day-to-day operation according to DOI and relevant procedure within the risk and control framework.
  • Execute and monitors workflow to ensure that processing/ documentation is delivered in accordance with required Standards.
  • Contributing ideas for improvements of processes and procedures.
  • Support and encourage others to practice in professional manner that reflect WRB HK MOX Credit Card 's service quality.
  • Completes work as assigned.
  • Ensure to report line manager all irregular issues and potential risks at the first time.
  • Fully support team cross support when need.
  • Support CN / HK business according to business requirements and team arrangement.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality services to customers through meeting or exceeding customer expectation guided by the Service Level Agreement, efficiency/accuracy standards and good business processes / judgment.

Key Measurables

  • Achievement of 105% productivity on daily basis.
  • Achievement of processing turnaround standard, no breach of SLA.
  • Achievement of accuracy standard, on a monthly basis, no less than 99.50%.
  • Achievement of a mix of 70% learning on-the-job, 20% learning from others and 10% formal learning. Meeting of performance objectives for self.
  • Contributing ideas for improvement on processes, procedures.
  • Update performance records and complete day end recon timely.

People & Talent

  • Network internally with colleagues to solve issue and improve efficiency.
  • Able to work in a team with good interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly so that understood by the recipients.
  • Understands that the action he/ she does has an impact on the customer directly or indirectly and be responsible/accountable for the actions undertaken.
  • Continue to seek improvement in team and operational process to achieve service and performance excellence.
  • Be a catalyst and a key team member in driving team activities.

Risk Management

  • Understands what the various risks are and some of the mandatory actions that need to be performed.
  • Escalates issues to senior management within parameters of role.
  • Describes the fundamentals of operations risk.
  • Take ownership for the identification of the risks and rectify as necessary depending on the circumstances.
  • Money Laundering Prevention
  • Responsible for any Money Laundering & Suspicious Transactions. Responsibilities also include the reporting of any suspicious transactions.
  • Ensures that appropriate internal controls are in place and operating effectively.
  • Staff should follow the code of conduct strictly, ensure the client information is secured and protected from leaking.

Governance

  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Understands and knows who the stakeholders are and meets SLAs.
  • Able to provide timely and accurate response to queries / request raised by stakeholders.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in WRB HK MOX Credit Card team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);

Skills And Experience

  • Retail Banking Services
  • Operational Risk
  • Process Improvement
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Self-study Ability
  • English
  • Cantonese

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above
  • Hold CET-4/6 Certifications
  • Good Business English & Cantonese Communication Skills.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control

Key Responsibilities

Processes

  • The CFCR function within the branch is the independent oversight on behalf of senior management of those core processes and related policies and procedures that seek to ensure the bank is in conformity with industry-specific laws and regulations in letter and spirit, thereby helping to maintain the bank’s reputation.
  • Ensure the effectiveness of the management of Compliance and Regulatory Risk issues by taking branch responsibility and leadership for compliance & Regulatory Risk. Promote, lead and manage the culture and practice of Compliance to ensure the conduct of business is within the letter and spirit of regulatory requirements and meets ethical standards.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, procedures and codes by establishing and maintaining frameworks within branch in order to protect the reputation of the bank and avoid significant financial loss.
  • Ensure, through the maintenance of appropriate frameworks and procedures, that material compliance and regulatory risks are anticipated, identified, escalated and reported to regional head and managed to mitigate risk, financial loss and damage to reputation.
  • Regular engagement to develop regulatory relationships with regulators including SAFE, PBOC, NFRA in the city with consistent adherence to regulatory expectations.
  • Provide advice to branch business & functions stakeholders on compliance with local regulatory matters relating to CFCR.
  • Support delivery of Compliance and AML Risk Assessments.
  • Support relevant stakeholders to respond to regulatory questions.
  • Ensure the branch is properly prepared for, routine regulatory exams, audits and supervisory inspections, as well as to managing the response from related stakeholders.
  • Co-ordination with other teams in the branch (e.g. CGM office, CIB, WRB, Ops) and / or HO functions / Business segments (e.g. Finance, Product, BORM, Risk) esp. for regulatory survey and reporting.
  • Assess the compliance risks of proposed new products/service in the branch prior to launch.
  • Active compliance supervision to ensure that the branch is aware of and observes both general and specific regulations that apply to their business activities. At branch level, independently summarize, document and assess the compliance risks associated with the branch business activities, consider ways to measure compliance risks and use various compliance programmes/tools to enhance compliance risk control. Assist management to identify and maintain compliance processes and procedures; identify potential compliance issues and advise on appropriate remedial action of responsible locations.
  • Fulfil specific statutory responsibilities (e.g. the role of local anti-money laundering officer, local NFRA approved person, etc.). Coordinate regulator meeting and liaise with relevant external bodies, assisting management to develop and maintain healthy regulatory relationships, coordinating and supporting on/offsite inspections, promptly follow up any identified deficiencies, and, where necessary, formulate proposals for amendments, rectifications.
  • Deliver compliance guidance and education programs across the branch network, based on assessment of local branch compliance quality, educating staff on branch-wide compliance issues and provide guidance to staff on the appropriate implementation of compliance laws, rules and standards through ad hoc training and gathering of local senior management.
  • Disseminating new and revised local regulations, policies and standards to the City network, interpret them on risk-based approach, ensure appropriate coverage across businesses and co-ordination among HO and local management functions. Assess the impact of, and provide guidance on, new and revised regulations, policies and standards.
  • Compile internal reports on a regular basis to senior management on compliance risk that has taken place within the city. Coordinate various types of ad hoc reports/surveys from regulators. Process local bank/product license/various local filing reports as requested. At City level summarize any identified breaches and/or deficiencies and the corrective measures recommended to address them, and report on corrective measures already taken to regulators.
  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, properly perform the duties of the leading department of fraud prevention on branch level in line with the requirements of internal policies & procedures and laws & regulations (e.g. coordinate relevant departments to implement the fraud prevention requirements forward by local regulator, collect and summarize case prevention work on branch level and coordinate with relevant departments to organize relative training etc), so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or negative reputational impact on the Bank.

Risk Management

  • Contribute to the effective management of risks across the branch through the branch MANCO.

Governance

  • Work jointly with the City General Manager to ensure that the city is adequately and appropriately governed.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • CGM, business lines and support functions at branch level (e.g. CGM office, Ops) and HO functions / Business segments (e.g. Finance, Product, Risk), Director and section chief of relevant department of local regulators.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China CFCR team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;

Skills And Experience

  • Sound knowledge of local regulatory requirements, local banking practices and requirements including but not limited to RMB XB and FX self-discipline mechanism, FTZ policy, credit bureau policy, individual FX policy, etc.
  • Strong local regulatory relationship management skills and have healthy relationships with key depts. of regulators, such as capital account division, current account division, BOP, AML, Financial stability, foreign bank supervisory department, etc.
  • Good understanding of the bank's overall business and operation for co-ordination with other teams
  • Good judgment enabling the provision of sound advice in ambiguity areas of regulation and practice and the proactive management of compliance and regulatory risk in the city
  • Deep knowledge of execution and supervision of the compliance related process, and that of regulatory requirement
  • Handle most compliance enquiry independently
  • Strong risk sense and the ability to assess risk in the branch

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or above; candidates with a Legal or Economic/Financial educational background are preferred.
  • Languages: Mandarin; English

Job Summary

  • Assist ME sales team in achieving agreed sales volume and profit objectives by acquiring, growing and retaining profitable SME Banking customers within acceptable risk parameters.
  • Be primarily responsible for client coverage and work closely as a team with the ME Relationship Manager in providing direct sales support on post origination activities like documentation, reporting, etc by engaging with client, CRC, legal, CFCR, etc.
  • Active engagement with client and also with the product partners to ensure high level of utilization of regular limits.
  • Work with the ME RM on a specified portfolio and jointly responsible for the revenue growth.
  • Compliance and CDD follow up for account maintenance.
  • Tracking and completion of monthly reports including but not limited to HC, performance, RM code management.
  • In line with the commitment to serve SME segment by supporting their high-quality development needs, SME department will continue to extend the coverage of financial services, uplift comprehensive financial service capabilities for SMEs, as well as provide one-bank financial solution to support SMEs’ whole life cycle growth (from start-up to cross-border expansion).

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Business

  • Achieve individual financial and non-financial targets while contributing towards team’s overall deliverables through:
  • Effectively generating new business – identify prospects and convert in line with the Bank’s appetite.
  • Strategically formulating account plan – provide clients’ needs-based solutions, structure appropriate credit facility, and execute various banking transactions.
  • Proactively building trusted client relationships – maintain a portfolio of active and growing customers.
  • Build and expand existing client relationships through pro-active contact, account planning, wallet sizing and effective pipeline management.
  • Identify and prioritize activities to maximize revenue contribution from allocated client portfolio.
  • Consult and recommend strategies where account management or recovery is needed on problem accounts, assisting credit in identifying sources from minimizing loan losses.
  • Work effectively across geographic borders with customers to deepen relationships with the Bank.
  • Generate creative ideas on customer acquisition and products/ services.
  • To provide one-stop service to SME banking upper segment clients with flexible financial solutions, multi-channel servicing and cross-border capabilities, including commercializing business opportunities of cash management solution, supply chain management, cross-border proposition and working capital financing.
  • To collaborate with CCIB/Affluent to provide total solution to growing enterprise.
  • Keep abreast of SME banking market in term of products and services across markets and among competitors, to support the SME Banking in driving key products and/or service.
  • Assist CPMS product sales to provide relevant service (including. FX forward, Structured Deposit and other etc.) to SME banking upper segment clients based on their needs.
  • Responsible for identifying the business monitoring and testing and reporting findings, exceptions, and results from monitoring/testing activities.
  • To monitor and ensure strict execution of KYC policy within the SME Banking.
  • To constantly operate within the compliance’s guidelines set by group standard and/or local regulations.

People & Talent

  • Perform professionally as a team player to lead, co-work, or support in all SME Banking related initiatives.
  • Enhance & multiply the quality & depth of direct reports in SME Banking family.
  • Drive performance through clear objectives via KPIs.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Ensure effective and efficient operations without sacrifice on control and service quality. Continually look at opportunities for process improvements.

Job Summary

  • This role drives SME new-client acquisition by executing targeted sales strategies, achieving KPI/scorecard goals, managing a strong prospect pipeline, and delivering compliant one-bank financial solutions across clients’ full growth lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Actively implement the defined client acquisition strategy for SME banking, ensuring your daily sales activities are fully aligned with the bank’s overall growth objectives.
  • Work with stakeholders to ensure achievement of Segment-view acquiring targets.
  • Expertly articulate the bank’s value proposition and execute the go-to-market market strategy in client interactions, effectively differentiating our offers from competitors.
  • Ensure accurate and timely delivery of client journeys, scripts and offers to ensure a consistent, high-quality, and compliant sales process for all new client acquisitions.
  • In line with the commitment to serve SME segment by supporting their high-quality development needs, SME department will continue to extend the coverage of financial services, uplift comprehensive financial service capabilities for SMEs, as well as provide one-bank financial solution to support SMEs’ whole life cycle growth (from start-up to cross-border expansion).

Business

  • Be directly accountable for achieving the targets for acquiring new target clients as scorecard required, contributing directly to the segment’s growth. For the scenarios that will trigger Performance Improvement Plan (PIP), please refer to the SME Banking Sales Productivity Management Mechanism and the local performance/productivity requirements setup by regional/city management per region/city business strategies.
  • Work closely with the segment, product and other stakeholders to understand target client profiles, value propositions and performance standards (KPI) and effectively execute the defined sales and growth strategies.
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of prospective clients, ensuring a steady flow of high-quality opportunities.
  • Partner effectively with CIB/Affluent to identify and action collaboration opportunities, ensuring a seamless client experience and maximizing business potential.

Processes

  • Contribute towards improving the end-to-end process for SME with focus on quality in delivery and cycle time.
  • Manage the productivity and efficiency of the value stream jointly with Functional Business Heads
  • Leverage CRM systems to track performance, manage the pipeline, and ensure strict process adherence.

Job Objective

We are a leading technology hub in Guangzhou, dedicated to innovation and excellence in the tech industry. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated risk manager role with focus mainly on operational risk to strengthen DTC’s overall risk control resiliency. This role is pivotal in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, as well as ensuring stringent compliance with internal policies, processes and external regulations and providing continuous guidance and support to BU/SU on Risk/ LCS subjects.

Principal Responsibilities

Assist in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, including but not limited to:

  • Responsible for implementation of corporate operational risk PSG within the unit.
  • Responsible for development and implementation of unit-specific operational risk PSG and procedures.
  • Review proposed deviations from corporate and unit-specific operational risk policies and standards and residual risk rating.
  • Analyse and identify emerging trends and potential operational risks, including tracking and management reporting, e.g. Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicator (KRI), pre-audit assessment.
  • Run regular unit risk forum and attend group-level risk forum where required.
  • Oversee Business Continuity Management (BCM) and incident management.
  • Manage operational risk initiatives and target reviews.
  • Proactive in forging effective engagement with key stakeholders on overall risk management and governance matters.
  • Design and implement operational risk measures as part of DTC’s operational risk monitoring process.
  • Review and update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures.
  • Promote staff awareness, follow and track compulsory trainings and consequence management.
  • Other risk management related work as assigned by manager.

This role would also provide certain support to LCS (Legal, Compliance & Secretariat) function where needed, including but not limited to:

  • Identify, advise and manage legal/ regulatory risks associated with the operation of business and other related matters.
  • Update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures/ documentations where needed.

Other LCS related work as assigned by manager.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Full-time bachelor degree holder (with law or risk management related major being a plus); master degree is preferred.
  • Minimum 8-year experience in legal/ compliance or risk management domain.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in identifying, assessing, treating, monitoring, reporting, and advising on corporate risk management.
  • Excellent organizational, problem solving, interpersonal and operating skills to independently and effectively drive tasks.
  • Experience in technology industry is an advantage.

Functional / Technical Competencies

  • Strong written and oral communication skills (in both English and Chinese), analytical and solution-oriented.

  • Strong ability to prioritize, self-motivated, independent and able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

ln:4455242168.descriptionHtml:
About DBS Bank

DBS is a leading financial services group in Asia, committed to making banking joyful and impactful for customers. We are transforming the future of banking through innovation and technology, empowering individuals and businesses to thrive in the digital economy.

About The Team

The Future Ready Tech (FRT) department is primarily responsible for implementing and maintaining the bank's technology platforms, ensuring their reliability and resilience, while providing support for innovation and collaboration. The department is committed to enhancing customer experience through experimentation and partnerships with external collaborators, and strives to make DBS the best workplace.

Job Responsibilities

As an Application Developer within the Future Ready Tech (FRT) department, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative AI-driven software solutions. The FRT department is primarily responsible for implementing and maintaining the bank's technology platforms, with a main focus on GenAI applications, ensuring platform reliability and resilience while providing support for innovation and collaboration.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Developing, testing, and deploying high-quality, scalable, and resilient applications for banking operations, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks to enhance customer experience.
  • Generative AI: Leading the development and integration of Generative AI (GenAI) models into banking applications, contributing to advanced analytical and predictive capabilities. This involves working with GenAI platforms and leveraging AI services to drive digital transformation.
  • System Design and Architecture: Participating in the architectural design of new and existing AI-powered systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and adhere to best practices in terms of performance, security, and scalability.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Collaboration: Working closely with business stakeholders, data scientists, product managers, and other developers to understand business needs and translate them into innovative technical solutions that support FRT's mission to make DBS the best workplace.
  • Troubleshooting and Support: Providing technical support and troubleshooting for production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical banking systems.
  • Documentation: Creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation for applications and systems.
  • Innovation: Staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in areas like AI, cloud computing, and fintech, through experimentation and partnerships with external collaborators to drive continuous improvement and innovation within the FRT team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficient in Java8+ programming language and familiar with mainstream frameworks such as Spring Boot/Spring Cloud.
  • Proficient in Python programming language.
  • Experienced in CI/CD deployment processes and tools, with expertise in automated deployment.
  • Experienced in Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift.
  • Familiar with Linux operating system and possess basic shell scripting skills.
  • Familiar in and able to efficiently utilize various database technologies, including but not limited to: Elasticsearch (ES), MariaDB, and Redis.

  • 销售银行产品和服务
    1) 通过交叉销售、客户推荐、主动升級销售、个人业务关系等方式，获得新客户和拓展新的业务。
    2) 通过审慎的财务需求分析/规划确认现有/预期客户的财务需求，推销已获得该城市监管主体许可的存款和理财产品。

    4) 参加各种销售和推广活动（例如实地推广、公司推销活动、路演等），以扩展客户基础和业务网络，在该城市推广银行的形象/品牌。
    5) 向 丰盛理财中心经理 反映客户反馈和竞争情况并提出建议。

  • 建立关系和个人账户服务
    1) 与现有客户保持定期联络，以加强关系，减少客户流失。
    2) 为客户提供最新的产品/市场信息及其账户状况，以增加账户 使 用 率 和产品渗透率。
    3) 为客户开设账户，完成申请和相关文档。
    4) 处理客户的 查 询。
    5) 了解最新的产品/市场知识和财务需求分析/规划技能，在与客户交流时展现出高水平的专业能力。

  • 客户体验管理
    1) 按照银行要求的服务标准为客户提供最优质的服务。
    2) 处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，以确保客户满意度。

    教育背景和相关工作经验要求：
    拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑；
    普通话必须流利；
    对当地银行惯例和规定具有良好的理解。

    工作经验：
    至少拥有在中国财务市场上的 3 年的销售经验。

    资质：
    拥有基金从业资格证

    专业技能要求：

    1. 产品和财务知识:
    有关银行的产品和服务的知识

ln:4418156403.descriptionHtml:
Job Objective

DBS Bank is a leading financial services group in Asia, committed to leveraging technology to redefine banking. The DBS Technology Centre (DTC) is the Group's AI-powered technology hub, playing a crucial role in advancing DBS's AI capabilities and integrating AI deeply into the entire value chain of banking operations and services. DTC aims to strengthen core technological capabilities and empower technology with AI to enhance business resilience and strategic competitiveness across all core markets, working collaboratively with Group Technology to achieve the vision of becoming the "Best AI-Enabled Bank with a Heart".

The AI Tech Head (Future Ready / Applied AI) role within DTC will be a visionary leader responsible for spearheading the implementation and evolution of future-proof technological platforms and innovations. This role is critical in driving the "Future Ready Technology" mandate, which focuses on ensuring reliable and resilient platforms, fostering innovation and collaboration, and continuously experimenting with external partners to deliver exponential customer and employee experiences. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in injecting innovation across product and service development within and across platforms, particularly in areas leveraging AI, to align with DTC's strategic objectives.

Principal Responsibilities

Applied AI & Agentic AI Strategy Implementation:

  • Lead the development and execution of the technology strategy for Future Ready Technology within DTC, aligning with the overall Group Technology Mandate and DTC's AI-driven vision.
  • Lead the departmental Applied AI strategy planning and execution, focusing on the practical application and scaled implementation of AI in banking operations, rather than foundational model research and development.
  • Apply large model capabilities to core business and internal efficiency scenarios, continuously creating business and operational value through Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, voice, and collaborative intelligence.
  • Champion the continuous injection of innovation in product and service development, both within and across platforms, with a strong focus on AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
  • Continuously explore and leverage external partnerships to provide exponential customer experiences.

Agentic AI platform and framework development

  • Ensure the stability, scalability, and security of technology platforms within the Future Ready Technology domain.
  • Drive technological synergy and optimization through stronger collaboration among different platforms.
  • Focus on leveraging innovation and future-of-work technology to improve both customer and employee journeys.
  • Responsible for the technical direction and implementation of the AI Agent platform and development system, including AI development IDEs (e.g., Claude Code) and frameworks such as DIFY, Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph, and Claude Agent SDK.
  • Drive the implementation of AI-driven process automation and digital workflow systems.

AI Security, Observability & Governance

  • Design and implement enterprise-level AI security architecture, including Agent Identity, OAuth, permissions management, and data access control.
  • Establish AI system observability, traceability, and evaluation mechanisms to ensure stability, security, and audit compliance.
  • Lead AI governance and risk management initiatives.

Future of Work & Collaborative Intelligence

  • Promote the integration of AI with collaboration tools like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace to drive transformation in future work styles.
  • Responsible for voice-related AI technical directions (STT/TTS, Image Processing, Video Generation, etc.).

Team Leadership and Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of technology professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
  • Lead a technology team and work closely with the Singapore team.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and best practices within DTC and across Group Technology.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in technology leadership roles within the relevant industry, with a strong focus on innovation, platform development, and emerging technologies.
  • Familiarity with Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, and Workflow Design.
  • Experience with Applied AI and enterprise-level systems.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex technology initiatives, particularly in areas related to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and future-ready platforms.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate large teams.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, capable of engaging with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. English as a working language is required.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive and innovative mindset.
