Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Title Senior Software Engineer II

Department FIL Dalian Systems

Location Dalian

Reports To Senior Manager

Level Grade 3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our FIL Dalian Systems team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

System department is to provide delivery and support services to internal systems.

About Your Role

The position is for an experienced senior Full Stack developer/specialist. The candidate will have deep expertise in backend development—particularly in Java, databases, and web service technologies—along with solid knowledge and hands‑on experience in application security, especially in API authentication.

The candidate should be able to implement complex business logic. As S/he may do development and deployment in the AWS environment, the AWS knowledge and experience would be a plus.

The successful candidate will deliver complex delivery tasks which would involve interaction with the business and system analysts for understanding the requirements followed by design, development and unit testing of the software. The candidate is expected to support global customers, so the English skill is required.

When required, the candidate will perform application performance tuning, identifying bottlenecks and implementing effective solutions.

The role may need support Fidelity Global partners such those in the Canada, UK, Indian, Hong Kong etc. based on business needs, the individual will need to work night shifts for 2-3 days per week (Shift working time from 1PM to 10 PM). An allowance will be provided on the shift day per company’s policy.

The candidate is expected to display professional ethics in his/her approach to work and exhibit a high level ownership within a demanding working environment.

About You

  • Extensive experience in Java/Web/API development.
  • Experience in Third party frameworks, Framework development experience, Oracle and SQL
  • Experience in workflow related technologies
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud systems
  • Experience software development to integrate with different backend systems
  • Experience in Tools that assist Development, Testing, Build and Source code Versioning.
  • Documentation skills and familiarity with project management methodologies.
  • API Integration Platform experience will be an added advantage.
  • Experience & good understanding of full development life cycle
  • Delivery and results focused.
  • Well presented with good communication skills.
  • Able to prioritise own activities, work under pressure.
  • Team player.
  • Business English is required.

One last point – if it goes without saying, it should not be included. This means things like ‘good communication skills’ and ‘basic computer competency’.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

ln:4467075044.descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Job Description

Title Senior Technical Consultant

Department Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services

Location Dalian

Reports To Head of Canada Services

Level Grade 6

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services provides technology delivery, engineering and operational support to Fidelity Clearing Canada (FCC). The team partners closely with FCC Technology, Product, Business and Operations to deliver, maintain and modernize business-critical platforms and services for external clients and internal business lines.

About Your Role

As Senior Technical Consultant, you will provide senior hands-on technical expertise for the maintenance, support and modernization of .NET-based trading systems within Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services. You will work across legacy application assessment, solution architecture, software engineering and technical delivery, helping the team understand existing codebases, reduce technology risk and define pragmatic modernization paths. A key part of the role will be to leverage AI-enabled engineering and code analysis tools, alongside traditional engineering practices, to accelerate codebase understanding, identify risks and dependencies, support refactoring and remediation, and help define and implement the target modernization approach. You will work closely with Technical Architecture, Product, Business, Operations, Information Security, engineering and vendor teams across FCC and FIL to translate business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions. The role requires strong hands-on .NET engineering capability combined with solution architecture and design skills, with responsibility spanning application maintenance, production support, refactoring, modernization, integration, technical debt reduction and engineering quality. Finance, trading system, capital-markets or investment domain knowledge is a plus.

What You Will Do

  • Provide senior hands-on technical leadership for the assessment, maintenance, enhancement and modernization of .NET-based trading applications and supporting services.
  • Analyse existing and legacy codebases, application architecture, dependencies and integrations to identify technical risks, maintainability concerns, end-of-life components and modernization opportunities, using AI-enabled code analysis tools where appropriate to accelerate and deepen the assessment.
  • Design and implement robust solutions using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET, RESTful APIs, SQL and related Microsoft technologies, applying appropriate architecture and integration patterns.
  • Define and implement pragmatic modernization and refactoring approaches that improve maintainability, reliability, security and scalability while protecting continuity of critical business services, leveraging AI-assisted engineering to accelerate remediation where appropriate.
  • Provide solution architecture and detailed technical design, including application components, APIs, integrations, data flows, deployment patterns and non-functional requirements.
  • Support application maintenance and Level 3 production support, including incident investigation, root-cause analysis, defect remediation, performance troubleshooting and application upgrades.
  • Promote strong engineering practices covering automated testing, code quality, secure coding, CI/CD, observability, documentation, operational readiness and technical debt management, ensuring AI-generated recommendations and code are appropriately reviewed and validated.
  • Work closely with architecture, business, product, operations, security, infrastructure and vendor teams to understand requirements, evaluate solution options and coordinate delivery dependencies.
  • Provide technical estimation, implementation planning and clear communication of technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies and remediation priorities to Canada Services and FCC stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI-enabled engineering tools to accelerate code understanding, dependency and risk analysis, refactoring, modernization, testing and documentation, while applying strong technical judgement and appropriate architecture, security, quality and governance controls.

About You

You bring extensive hands-on software engineering experience with strong expertise in C# and the Microsoft .NET technology stack, including development, maintenance and modernization of complex enterprise applications. You have demonstrated solution architecture and technical design capability and can move comfortably between architecture-level decisions and hands-on code analysis and implementation. You have experience assessing legacy applications, refactoring complex codebases, managing technical debt and remediating obsolete or end-of-life technologies. You understand APIs and integration patterns, SQL and relational databases, secure software development, automated testing, CI/CD and production support for business-critical systems. You are comfortable leveraging AI-enabled software engineering tools for code analysis, codebase understanding, refactoring, testing, documentation and modernization, while critically validating AI-generated outputs and applying appropriate security, architecture and engineering controls. You can troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and work effectively across distributed business, technology and vendor teams. Experience with AI-assisted software engineering is highly desirable. Finance or financial-services domain knowledge, particularly experience with trading systems, capital markets or investment platforms, is a plus.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Details of the Division and Team

Transactional FX is a high-profile joint venture between the Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB). Transactional FX team is responsible for delivering one of the fastest growing revenue streams in CB & IB by providing market leading FX workflow solutions to clients. Transactional FX leverages the firm’s position as a market leader in CB and offers variety of standard and bespoke FX solutions to solve for client’s FX workflow needs.

What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

The role focuses on the end-to-end implementation process of TFX solutions on both the CB and the IB side of the setup. The implementation/project manager has full responsibility for the end-to-end execution of FX4Cash implementation deals for CB clients. The deals may include customized client business requirements, testing coordination, training/coaching (internally and externally) and the setup of highly technical products in multiple phases.   • Ability to effectively interface with people at multiple levels in the organization.

  • Excellent office skills to include experience with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Good conceptual grasp of FX payments, pricing and market terminology
  • Knowledge of Corporate cash management and general correspondence banking
  • Knowledge and experience in analytical tools like Tableau would be added advantage
  • Experience in Implementation or operations would be added advantage

  • Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment, prioritizes multiple tasks, and meets strict deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication skills and problem-solving skills
  • Experience of working in KPI-driven, performance-metric focused, timeliness and quality focused environment

Job Description

The Client Manager is a client facing banker responsible for a seamless execution on onboarding and implementation, service coordination and credit management. This position acts as a central point of contact for clients and internal partners, ensuring operational efficiency and effective relationship support.

Responsibilities

Relationship & Origination Support

  • Maintain professional and strategic relationships with key client representatives and decision-makers.
  • Originates and executes client transactions on Client Manager covered clients, managing day-to-day client interactions, deal structuring, financial analysis, and coordination with internal partners to delivery mandates.
  • Execute key strategic business campaigns, including comprehensive account planning, wallet sizing, and corridor or product initiatives.
  • Understand client drivers and support Subsidiary Account Managers, Regional Account Managers (RAMs) and Parent Account Managers (PAMs), as applicable, in origination activities.
  • Mentor junior Client Managers in understanding client needs and identifying business opportunities.


Credit Management

  • Oversee and manage credit requests in close coordination with various internal teams, providing input and ensuring timely resolution.
  • Timely oversight and guidance on credit risk mitigation, monitoring credit lines, and escalating exceptions.


Onboarding & Implementation

  • Manage the end-to-end client onboarding experience for clients, from initiating requests to post-implementation follow up.
  • Identify best practices for client documentation and facilitate comprehensive client training programs to ensure a seamless and efficient transition for clients.


Service Coordination

  • Act as a primary escalation point and trusted advisor for strategic clients, expertly managing and resolving client issues.
  • Facilitate operational efficiency and client satisfaction by optimizing day-to-day operational flows, analyzing client feedback, and identifying proactive solutions.


KYC Ownership

  • Oversee and ensure the integrity of KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for a portfolio of clients.
  • Take responsibility for completing, maintaining, and reviewing accurate client profiles, and mentor junior team members on KYC best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

Experience: 6-10 years of Experience in client management or a related role within the financial services industry.

Technical Skills: Advanced product knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of operational processes and in-depth knowledge of KYC/AML regulatory requirements.

Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.

Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to resolve complex, multi-faceted client issues, manage high-stakes escalations, and drive process improvements through strategic solutions.

Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong commitment to delivering a high level of client service and ability to develop and maintain robust, executive-level client relationships and influence key stakeholders. Proven planning, negotiation and analytical skills.

Attention to Detail: Meticulous accuracy and unwavering attention to detail in all aspects of work, critical for managing high-value client portfolios.

Education

  • Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred.

ln:4467476251.descriptionHtml:
Regulatory Compliance

Regulatory Compliance ensures adherence to applicable regulations and standards by setting the policies which cover HSBC’s regulatory requirements, and mitigate conduct and reputational risk issues. The team strives to remain ahead of the regulatory change agenda and ensures the business understands the implications and is prepared for change. It monitors how the Global Businesses and Functions manage their responsibilities with regard to complying with the regulations and helps resolve compliance deficiencies.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive branch business, function and staff implement HBCN's Compliance (CMP) Policy and Procedure, strictly observe the law, regulation, local regulatory requirement and relevant Compliance rules; oversight branch compliance team discharge their role and responsibility (if applicable)
  • Understand, interpret and disseminate local regulatory requirement and oversight relevant stakeholders to implement including provide advice accordingly. Participate Compliance Review on significant branch decision by providing opinion of local regulatory requirement
  • Conduct compliance check which in line with CNQ' s Compliance Assurance' plan and timely report CNQ Compliance and Branch Manager the significant actual or potential breach / compliance risk, participate handling material compliance issue and RAC management
  • Participate BPA exercise on branch and providing compliance related opinion to the appraisal leading department
  • Proactively maintain sound working relationship and collaboration with local primary financial regulators and lead cooperation with regulatory inspection, review and daily communication. Oversight relevant stakeholders to remediate the regulatory finding or issue.
  • Establish branch CMP training mechanism to deliver regular compliance training to ensure branch staff understand regulatory requirement, bank CMP policy and guidance and constantly improve staff's compliance awareness.
  • Proactively cooperate with Risk or Financial Crime (FC) to support branch management effectively oversight branch operational risk and financial crime risk as well as internal control mechanism according to relevant procedure and guidance. Supports second LOD risk management oversight activity for other Risk function, in specific aligned risk area like Financial Crime Compliance Risk, Operational Risk and Reputational Risk at branch, by collaborative work with relevant risk SME and stewards.
  • Implement other role and responsibility required for branch Compliance Officer and team by Group and HBCN policy and procedure.

Your appointment will be subject to regulatory approval by the National Financial Regulatory Administration(“NFRA”)/China Securities Regulatory Commission (“CSRC”). Upon approval, you will be classified as China Local Material Risk Taker (MRT) and the MRT terms and conditions specified in HBCN/RRB/HACN/INSH/IBCN Variable Pay Deferral Guide will be applicable to any variable pay that may be awarded to you.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree holder (BA or above);
  • Work experience in financial industry and in legal and compliance management; or meet the mandatory qualification requirement on Branch Compliance Officer;
  • Professional knowledge and skill on legal, compliance management and risk management (including AML and FC related area) to fulfil the job-holder's responsibility
  • Mature interpersonal and communication skills (including fluent oral and written in English/Chinese formal reporting), team spirit, and capacity to influence stakeholder;
  • Good project management experiences and ability to establish healthy relationships with both internal and external partners; and
  • Self-motivated, open and strong willingness to achieve under pressure and manage changes.

Job Summary

This role could be based in India or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

The Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) organisation is instrumental in protecting and ensuring the resilience of Standard Chartered Bank’s operations, data, and IT systems by managing operational, technology and cyber risk across the enterprise. Reporting into the Group Chief Risk Officer (CRO), the Group OTCR team serves as the second line of defence for assuring that controls are implemented effectively, in accordance with the OTCR Framework, and for instilling a risk culture within the Bank.

Key Responsibilities

The Director, OTCR, Strategic & Emerging Risks for| AI & ML, will play a crucial role in the second line of defence, responsible for overseeing and challenging the management of risks associated with the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) within Cyber Security and Technology. This role will focus on ensuring the effective identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of AI-related risks, contributing to the development and implementation of a robust AI risk management framework. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cyber security principles, and risk management best practices.

Strategy

  • AI Though Leadership: Provide though leadership on the emerging trends and best practices across Cyber and Technology risk. Input into strategic and emerging risk identification and management capabilities to enable the bank to take a forward looking and proactive stance in the management of AI related risks.

Business

  • AI Though Leadership: Provide though leadership on the emerging trends and best practices across Cyber and Technology risk. Input into strategic and emerging risk identification and management capabilities to enable the bank to take a forward looking and proactive stance in the management of AI related risks.
  • AI Risk Framework Development & Implementation: Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of a comprehensive AI risk management framework, aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Risk Identification & Assessment: Proactively identify and assess emerging AI-related risks across Cyber Security and Technology, considering both current and future AI applications. This includes evaluating risks related to Technology, operational risk and security vulnerabilities and design.
  • Risk Mitigation & Control Evaluation: Evaluate the design and effectiveness of controls implemented by the first line of defence to mitigate identified AI risks. Challenge and provide recommendations for improvement where necessary.
  • Monitoring & Reporting: Establish and execute ongoing monitoring activities to track the effectiveness of AI risk management controls. Prepare and present regular reports on AI risk posture to senior management and relevant committees.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Cyber Security, Technology, Data and other relevant departments to ensure a consistent and coordinated approach to AI risk management.
  • Knowledge & Expertise: Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI/ML technologies, cyber security threats, and regulatory landscape related to AI. Share knowledge and best practices with the broader organization.
  • Policy & Guidance: Contribute to the development and maintenance of policies, standards, and guidelines related to the responsible use of AI within the organization.
  • Challenge & Oversight: Provide independent challenge and oversight of the first line of defence’s management of AI risks.

Processes

  • Second Line of Defence oversight of AI related processes.

People & Talent

  • Support the training, develop and upskilling of the wider team on Security and AI.

Risk Management

  • Support the effective identification, assessment and management of risk.

Governance

  • Ensure good governance and management of identified risk and issues.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Data and Responsible AI teams.
  • Cyber Security and Technology Teams.
  • CISO’s
  • Group Internal Audit

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in OTCR TTO. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

Skills And Experience

  • Information Security Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk Management
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
  • Governance, Regulation and Risk Management - Risk and Control
  • Communicating Complex Concepts
  • Information Security Technologies
  • Emerging Technologies

Who are we looking for?

Someone Who

  • Has a deep technical expert who has practical experience working across Cyber Security, Technology and Artificial Intelligence.
  • Is for a self-starter, who is willing to continually learn and develop to stay at the cutting edge of best practice.
  • Can collaborate and share knowledge to help the process of upskilling the developing the broader ICS and Technology community.
  • Displays intellectual curiosity and integrity.
  • Is trusted and respected as a thought leader who can influence and persuade business and IT leaders and IT development teams.
  • Can balance the long-term (big picture) and short-term implications of individual decisions. Can make informed and pragmatic risk decision and provide balanced advice.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead cross-functional teams

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

DBS Tech China is hiring a deeply technical, hands-on engineering leader to drive key wealth management initiatives and investment journeys. This role is suited to a strong full stack engineer who can own a stream end to end, lead one or more engineering squads, and stay close to architecture, design, and implementation.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of modern wealth management platforms and investment journeys within your stream.
  • Act as a hands-on technical leader for one or more engineering squads, driving strong technical execution and engineering standards.
  • Develop and mentor engineering talent, foster a high-performing culture, and take ownership of career growth and retention for your team members.
  • Build and evolve full stack systems across a modern stack that includes Java, ReactJS.
  • Design scalable distributed solutions across microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Own solution design and engineering delivery for your area, ensuring alignment with broader platform and architecture direction.
  • Work closely with product, business, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Contribute directly to key design decisions, implementation approaches, and critical delivery paths.
  • Evaluate and apply modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development tooling, where they can improve speed, quality, and developer effectiveness.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms in a hands-on engineering role.
  • Deep expertise in one or more of these core technologies: Java, ReactJS, Python, and Go, with strong full stack engineering capability.
  • Proven experience designing scalable, resilient, high-performance systems in customer-facing or transaction-heavy environments.
  • Strong architectural knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, and modern micro-frontend patterns.
  • Experience leading a stream or domain area while working closely with one or more engineering squads.
  • Strong experience building order management systems and execution management systems.
  • Strong domain experience in areas such as Bonds, Equities, FX, Structured Products, Funds, Digital Assets, or advisory domains such as portfolio construction, rebalancing, and risk management.
  • Experience in credit or banca domains is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: Group Functions Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Support the design and delivery of a prevention-first, intelligence-led Financial Crime technology architecture.
  • Take an end-to-end view across Financial Crime journeys, including prevention, detection, decisioning, alerting, investigation, regulatory reporting, data, and feedback loops.
  • Translate business needs into clear, practical technology solutions and phased delivery plans.
  • Help modernise legacy applications into cloud-hosted, API-driven, event-enabled, and data-led platforms.
  • Identify and shape appropriate AI/ML use cases, such as intelligent triage, real-time risk assessment, decision support, search, summarisation, workflow automation, and operational insights.
  • Assess AI/ML opportunities based on business value, user need, data readiness, technical feasibility, control effectiveness, explainability, operational adoption, and governance.
  • Encourage reusable capabilities, common integration patterns, and real-time data services that can be used across Financial Crime domains.
  • Work with engineering, architecture, security, data, infrastructure, and operations teams to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and supportable.
  • Drive good engineering practices across architecture, delivery quality, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, release controls, and production readiness.
  • Provide technical challenge and support to delivery teams, helping resolve blockers and maintain momentum.
  • Coach engineers and technical leads, raising capability in modern engineering, cloud, data, DevOps, and AI-assisted delivery.
  • Build strong working relationships across global teams and help align stakeholders around delivery priorities and architecture decisions.

Requirements

Technology and solution capability

  • Broad technical understanding across modern application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, cloud platforms, data, DevOps, security, and automation.
  • Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects, review solution designs, identify risks, and challenge technical decisions constructively.
  • Experience contributing to technology modernisation, cloud migration, application integration, or platform transformation initiatives.
  • Working understanding of data platforms, data quality, real-time and batch integration, and how data supports decisioning and analytics.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, observability, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Awareness of AI/ML solution patterns, including machine learning, LLM-based applications, RAG, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted engineering.
  • Understanding of the principles behind MLOps or LLMOps, including controlled deployment, monitoring, governance, and operational support.
  • Experience in Agile delivery environments, with exposure to tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Jenkins, Terraform, or equivalent.

Business and Financial Crime acumen

  • Ability to connect technology choices to business value, customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness.
  • Good understanding of Financial Crime, fraud, risk, compliance, or regulated operational environments. Experience in banking is preferred.
  • Ability to think across an end-to-end business journey rather than focus only on a single application or process step.
  • Curiosity about how AI/ML, data, and automation can improve Financial Crime outcomes in a responsible and practical way.
  • Ability to balance innovation with security, governance, resilience, delivery feasibility, and operational sustainability.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Demonstrated ability to drive change in a complex organisation, influence stakeholders, and turn strategic direction into practical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Do you like financial markets? Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets? Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?

We are seeking an experienced Market Conduct Surveillance Analyst with deep practitioner experience, capable of operating with a high degree of independence while remaining fully embedded within an integrated regional surveillance framework. In this role, you will:

  • Perform end‑to‑end trade surveillance activities across the Investment Bank (IB) and Global Wealth Management (GWM) businesses, with primary accountability for China‑local activity.
  • Independently analyze alerts, exceptions and instances of potentially unusual or suspicious trading activity generated by surveillance systems, forming well‑reasoned conclusions.
  • Apply deep, practical knowledge of China local securities regulations, including Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, when assessing and determining market conduct risk.
  • Leverage a strong understanding of cash equities and related IB & GWM products, execution processes, trading strategies and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle to support robust and defensible investigations.
  • Act as the primary surveillance authority for China‑local activity, exercising a high degree of independent analysis, judgment and decision‑making in risk assessments and outcomes.
  • Engage directly with front‑office businesses, control functions and regional partners on escalations, inquiries and remediation actions, challenging where appropriate.
  • Represent surveillance function in interactions with exchange surveillance teams and regulators, including responding to inquiries and managing follow‑ups as required.
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues as part of an integrated APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team, actively participating in regional training and knowledge sharing initiatives to promote cross market consistency while addressing China specific market conduct risks.
  • Drive continuous process improvements and contribute to strategic initiatives, automation and optimization projects within the function.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with senior management and key stakeholders across the first and second lines of defence in China and across the region, establishing credibility as a trusted subject‑matter expert.

The team

You will be part of the APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team functionally, a second‑line function within Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control, supporting the firm in achieving its strategic, operational and regulatory objectives.

The role is based in Shanghai, with primary accountability for China‑local trade surveillance activities. In addition to day‑to‑day surveillance coverage, the role will play a key part in establishing and further developing the Market Conduct Surveillance operating model in China, aligned with existing APAC governance, standards and escalation frameworks.

While operating with a high degree of independence in line with local regulatory and data‑privacy requirements, the role is fully integrated within the broader APAC regional framework, providing exposure to regional governance, escalation practices and cross‑market regulatory expectations, alongside focused ownership of China‑specific market conduct risks.

Your Skills And Experience

  • Proven hands‑on experience in market conduct and/or trade surveillance within a financial institution or securities regulator.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with automated trade surveillance systems, including scenario design and system configuration, with the ability to independently review, assess and dispose of alerts and to propose enhancements to surveillance coverage where appropriate.
  • Strong knowledge of China securities market regulations, with particular emphasis on Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, and proven ability to apply these rules in both the design and tuning of surveillance scenarios and the independent assessment and disposition of alerts.
  • Demonstrated experience independently handling exchange‑driven surveillance inquiries and regulatory referrals from SSE/SZSE, including analysis, response formulation and follow‑up.
  • Solid understanding of execution processes for cash equities and related instruments, including order handling, execution workflows and post‑trade processes.
  • Strong understanding of trading strategies, market behavior and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle, enabling meaningful and well‑reasoned analysis of suspicious or unusual trading activity.
  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to investigate issues in depth, identify root causes and reach sound, defensible conclusions.
  • Excellent organizational, time‑management, documentation and problem‑solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Commitment to staying current on regulatory developments, internal policy changes and evolving market practices.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, confidently and credibly with a broad range of stakeholders, including senior business and compliance stakeholders and regional partners.

Job Description

  • Group Internal Audit (GIA) is looking for an experienced and dynamic audit professional with a solid background and strong knowledge around the key risks and controls in the Finance, Property and Treasury functions.
  • The role-holder will be an integral part of the Finance, Property (East) and Treasury (East) Audit team. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of the Finance, Property and Treasury functions globally.
  • We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking.
  • This role currently reports to Head of Audit Vietnam, Australia and Finance, Property (East) and Treasury (East).

Key Responsibilities

  • To act as Team Lead/ Team Member, as necessary, and take responsibility for contributing to the delivery of high-quality Finance, Property and Treasury function audits, the performance of which cause minimal disruption to the business.
  • To role model the valued behaviours and develop an environment in which positive behaviours are celebrated and poor culture is challenged.
  • To execute assigned audit work, as well as the work carried out by the team, in an efficient and effective manner, within the given budget and timelines, and in line with GIA methodology standards.
  • To clearly identify the risks and impact of issues during issue writing, agreeing these issues with management and obtaining quality management action plans to mitigate the risks raised.
  • To support GIA audit teams by providing product knowledge and expertise for their audits relating to the individual’s area of responsibility.
  • Issue validation: All audit issue action plans agreed during audit fieldwork should be tracked through to completion in accordance with methodology requirements.
  • To prepare and provide information for various country reports for submission to the regulator or management as required by the Country Head of Audit.

Strategy

  • Audits assigned to the individual in the GIA audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIA.
  • Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.

Business

  • Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements

Processes

  • To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
  • When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
  • When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
  • Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
  • Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
  • Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIA system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIA system requirements.
  • Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.

People & Talent

  • Share knowledge to increase specialism within the function.
  • Influence change within the department by highlighting potential enhancements.
  • Identify growth areas on an ongoing basis and identify how best to develop them.
  • When Team leading provide performance feedback, as appropriate at the end of an audit.
  • Identify and successfully complete key internal training for self-development.
  • Facilitate the development of audit team members by providing on the job training and recommending formal training to support GIA activities

Risk Management

  • Assist in the update of the assigned Continuous Risk Assessment on a regular basis to identify changes in risk profiles and document these in a timely manner, proposing changes to the assigned audit plan, as appropriate.
  • Promote early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to relevant stakeholders. Be prepared to raise issues/concerns outside the normal audit process.
  • Adopt an anticipatory approach to risk assessment through stakeholder engagement and monitoring of the external environment to improve audit planning; and
  • Review MI and reports regularly to keep up-to-date with key trends within the business and audit deliverables

Governance

  • Manage the relevant portfolio stakeholders and establish good working relationships to help the businesses improve the control environment and keep updated with changes in the business impacting their risk profile.
  • Use networks and relationships to build engagement and achieve results.
  • Escalate delays in the execution of audit work, both to auditee management and GIA Management.
  • Be able to clearly explain issues identified along with the risks and root causes to GIA and business management, using language designed to be understood by non-experts

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Support GIA to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Designated business stakeholders, typically related to assigned portfolio; and
  • GIA stakeholders – team leaders, team members, team managers, and Heads of Audit.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in GIA; and
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies.
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank.
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections.
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control, including but not limited to
  • contribute in the formulation or amendment of audit, risk control and accountability policies;
  • participate in the internal investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of failure to perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control.

Qualifications

  • Experience in audit, governance, risk or in a business environment.
  • Professional audit certification preferred.
  • Professional accounting or finance certification (CPA, CFA, etc) preferred.
  • Good communicator, both written and verbal, with an ability to influence and an ability to gain the respect of senior management, regional stakeholders, peers and their teams.
  • Confident and courageous to raise/escalate issues in a pro-active, professional and timely manner.
  • Self-directed and able to work with minimum supervision.

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Conduct investigations into concerns allegations or risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.
  • Ensure investigations align with relevant laws, regulations, and Group standards, including escalation, case management, data capture, evidence management, electronic evidence review, reporting, interviewing, and attending internal disciplinary panels.
  • Prioritize multiple investigations, tasks, projects, and responsibilities while maintaining positive stakeholder relationships.
  • Keep relevant stakeholders and appropriate senior management informed of relevant investigative developments.
  • Assist in regulatory and government investigations, including data source identification and extraction.
  • Develop and disseminate data analytics, providing relevant management information to stakeholders.
  • Maintain relationships with law enforcement and coordinate the provision of responses to search warrants, local production orders, court orders, request for information from regulators or law enforcement agencies, and attend Court as required.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • To manage the conduct of appropriate investigations in order to minimise financial losses, reputational and regulatory risks, and operational risk events involving criminal conduct, dishonesty or deliberate breaches of policies or regulations.

Business

  • Provide reports and other Management Information in agreed and standardised format.
  • Coordinate identification of themes, trends and lessons learnt from investigations in China to support the continuous improvement of the Bank’s conduct and control environment.

Processes

  • Conduct and manage non-government investigations against the Bank and/or with employees that have potential material impact on the Bank from either a reputational, regulatory, financial or litigation perspective (or any combination of the same).
  • As required, investigate data leakage cases escalated for China and assist in promoting awareness of the importance of confidentiality of bank information. Support management and promote Speaking Up in country with assistance from Regional investigative team.
  • Adopt a flexible approach in supporting other areas within the Group Investigations structure (and in seeking inbound support when necessary) to promote effective and efficient allocation of investigative resources.

People & Talent

  • Establish, develop and maintain close collaboration with key internal functional stakeholders. including Legal, Compliance, Audit, Risk, FCC and HR, to fully embed the Group Investigations framework including the formalisation of policies, procedures, processes and controls.

Risk Management

  • Maintain close interaction with those Risk Owners to whom responsibility is delegated to ensure resolution of system and control improvements identified through the Group Investigations process. Ensure Head, Shared Investigative Services, China, is fully informed of all key risks and issues in area of responsibility and reported in line with Bank’s operational risk process.

Governance

  • Reinforce an effective and exemplary risk and control culture and further strengthen the control environment.
  • Act to minimise operational loss and audit failures and take proactive measures to respond to matters arising.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Business and function representatives
  • HR
  • Compliance
  • Legal
  • Financial Crime Compliance
  • Audit
  • Risk

  • Interview
  • Investigation

  • 8-10 years investigative, compliance, intelligence, consulting or audit experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to run end-to-end investigations, audits or relevant reviews.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Relevant degree holder, or comparable experience.

  • 借助行内各种渠道,进行新客户开发,参与行内外组织的客户推介活动,积累客户资源
  • 为支行或分行营业部新客户提供客户开户服务和维护,日常咨询方面的需求,增加客户在我行的资产占比,以达到银行预期的业务和服务目标
  • 发展成为银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才

主要职责

渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户

  • 开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 负责新客户开发的全流程：对潜在客户进行定向触达和资质筛选，为新客户开立账户，完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到销售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。

协作式客户关系管理

  • 与客户经理紧密合作，与潜在客户积极互动，主动收集客户洞察（如风险偏好，财务目标等），确保客户交接顺畅和持续支持。
  • 向客户引介我行全球财富管理解决方案，突出贴合其财务目标的价值主张。
  • 主动处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，按照银行服务标准提供及时有效的解决方案，维持良好的客户满意度和留存率。

审计和合规控制

  • 遵守银行的政策、标准、操作准则/规程、安保及内部控制和合规措施，尤其是分支机构当地的操作规程。
  • 遵守由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定，尤其是那些适用于销售过程的规则和规定。

职责管辖范畴

  • 丰盛理财业务发展经理向丰盛理财业务发展团队经理汇报，并需负责达到和超越本行所分配之各项销售指标。

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

教育经历

  • 拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑
  • 对外资银行工作抱有热忱

工作经验

  • 有相关销售经验和客户开发经验者优先

专业技能要求

  • 技术知识: 具备主动高效的客户沟通技巧，擅长通过专业化，场景化沟通话术
  • 多重任务: 能够驾驭多个优先事务，保持敏锐的关注和精力水平，管理时间，以获得积极的成果
  • 产品知识: 具备银行有关产品和服务知识者优先

Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team

Fixed Income & Currencies brings together a top-ranked institutional sales force, world-class research with trading and structuring expertise across Foreign Exchange, Rates, Credit and Emerging Markets. The Fixed Income & Currencies business enables Deutsche Bank to respond to increasing automation, regulatory expectations and client demand for standardisation and transparency in execution across fixed income, currency and emerging markets.

As the market leading international investment bank in APAC credit trading business, Deutsche Bank offers a fully-integrated and global credit product platform in the region. Working closely with regional trading, research and structure team, China ICG credit team provide China and global FI client with wide range of credit product for investment return, liquidity management, risks hedging, and cross boarder access purpose; Our products includes cash credit bonds, standard credit derivatives, securitised products, structure product in deposits, notes, repo, swaps etc.

Your Key Responsibilities And Required Skills

  • Support sales trading desks credit deal trades by
    • Have strong interest and be sensitive to the financial market,
    • Academically majored in related subjects, and had solid financial knowledge base.
    • Eager to learn, having humble attitude, and fast learner, and comfortable with interacting with people.
    • Strong summarizing, analysis, processing skills, and can be attentive to details.
    • Fluent in both Mandarin and English. Good translation skills.
  • Day to day task includes:
    • Collect, summarize, analyse , keeping and track market data movements, client appetites for trade ideas.
    • Taking regulatory training courses and be minded about local regulation for do’s and don't s
    • Assist team in market research, publicly traded company financial data collection and analysis, assist with KYC adoption and review work
    • Administrative work including record keeping, data mining/analysis, liaise with back office and other stake holders and reconcile trade status as and when needed
    • Require candidate to be able to communication well with the team, able to commit to work in terms of full attendance as agreed, and able to stay focused


We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

ln:4466848568.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The role sits in the Standard Charted Financial Markets Technology team focusing on the build out of the in-house strategic cross asset risk platform: SABRE, and the strategic market and reference data system: FALCON. The primary responsibility is to design, build, and operate scalable software services for market, static, and reference data, with strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and developer-friendly interfaces.

Whilst the SABRE platform has continuously been improved over the years to scale to an ever-increasing user base and a growing number of capabilities, amount of data and computation, its static and market data components have grown organically without going through any drastic transformation. The refreshed FM static and market strategy also provides a unique opportunity to realign the SABRE Static and Market Data Service (MDS) software architecture, interfaces and operational processes to that strategy.

As a Software Engineer, this role will help build a strategic platform that provides a unified data API and a centralized data store for intraday and EOD pricing and risk workflows. You will contribute across the full engineering lifecycle: architecture design, data model implementation, service development, integration, testing, production rollout, and continuous improvement.

FALCON Is Financial Markets’ Strategic Market And Reference Data Platform, Built To Unify How The Bank Sources, Stores, Manages, And Distributes Market Data Across All Asset Classes. Instead Of Today’s Fragmented Landscape — Multiple Systems, Duplicate Data Flows, Inconsistent Repositories, And Manual Curve Setups — FALCON Provides a Single, End To End Data Foundation For Real Time Intraday Prices, Historical Time Series, Official EOD Snaps, And Reference Data. From An Engineering Standpoint, The Platform Focuses On

  • Building high-throughput, low-latency data ingestion and distribution services.
  • Implementing robust data quality controls, lineage, and restatement capabilities.
  • Designing resilient APIs and event-driven workflows for downstream consumers.
  • Reducing operational risk through automation, observability, and controlled release processes.
  • Enabling rapid onboarding of new market observables through reusable platform components.
  • By consolidating market and reference data into one cohesive platform, this role directly improves the consistency and timeliness of data used by Front Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations, while creating a scalable technical foundation for future automation and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain business features in the FALCON platform using Java and related libraries.
  • Translate functional and data requirements into clean, scalable, and maintainable service implementations aligned with FALCON architecture standards.
  • Build and enhance core components for market and reference data workflows, including ingestion, validation, transformation, and distribution.
  • Implement and optimize REST/API integrations, messaging/event flows, and database access layers to support intraday and EOD use cases.
  • Write high-quality code with strong unit/integration test coverage, and ensure solutions meet performance, reliability, and security expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Business Analysts, QA, and peer engineers to clarify requirements, refine technical solutions, and deliver sprint commitments.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and defect resolution; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Support production releases and post-release stability by improving observability, logging, monitoring, and operational runbooks.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, and communicate mitigation plans to the team in a timely manner.
  • Continuously improve engineering practices through refactoring, automation, and contribution to shared platform components.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters

Key Stakeholders

  • Traders, quantitative analysts, middle office, operations, market risk, finance, business analysts, testers, project managers, support groups

Skills And Experience

  • Java Development and Backend Engineering
  • Backend Service Design and API HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket Development
  • Relational Databases and SQL Time Series Data and Data Modeling
  • High Concurrency and Performance Optimization
  • Financial Markets Domain Knowledge
  • Communication and Stakeholder Collaboration

Qualifications

  • 5-10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong focus on Java backend development in enterprise environments.
  • Strong proficiency in core Java, including object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, multithreading, memory/performance considerations, and common design patterns.
  • Solid experience with Maven, Git, and standard team-based development workflows including branching, code review, and version control best practices.
  • Proven experience in backend service development, including service design, API implementation, integration patterns, and building reliable, maintainable, and scalable distributed systems.
  • Good understanding of relational databases, including SQL design, query optimization, transactions, indexing, and data modeling.
  • Familiarity with time-series data storage and query patterns, especially for large-volume historical and intraday financial data.
  • Experience building systems for high-throughput and high-concurrency workloads, with strong understanding of performance tuning, asynchronous processing, caching, and resilience patterns.
  • Strong foundation in data structures and algorithms, with the ability to apply them pragmatically in production systems.
  • Hands-on experience with HTTP/HTTPS service development, RESTful APIs, and real-time communication technologies such as WebSocket.
  • Experience with search and indexing technologies is a plus; knowledge of Lucene or Lucene-based search solutions is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with containerization and deployment practices, including Docker and Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Basic to solid Linux command-line skills, including scripting with Shell for automation, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and standard software delivery processes, including build, test, packaging, deployment, and release controls.
  • Good understanding of software quality practices, including unit testing, integration testing, debugging, observability, and production issue analysis.
  • Experience with messaging, event-driven architecture, or batch/stream processing is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of security and secure coding fundamentals for backend services, including authentication, authorization, encryption in transit, and secrets handling.
  • Exposure to financial markets domain concepts is preferred, especially market data, reference data, pricing data, time series, or cross-asset workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of financial instruments and trading-related data concepts is beneficial, even if not at quantitative or pricing-model level.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work closely with engineers, QA, product partners, and business stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment.
  • Self-driven, delivery-focused, and able to manage priorities across multiple parallel workstreams.
  • High level of ownership, attention to detail, integrity, and willingness to support production systems when needed.
  • Languages: Chinese, English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. ln:4466862043.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  • Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, international environment.
  • Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.

Job Summary

  • To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
  • To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Perform detailed review of the reports to CPC/clients including: Verification trades to relevant supporting, Ensure valuation of investments being checked to third party sources, Ensure appropriate accounting for complex investment, Ensure compliance with internal investment restrictions, external regulations and international accounting standards, if applicable. Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
  • Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
  • To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
  • To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.
  • To ensure proper and accurate calculation and posting of management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum.
  • Recording and disbursing dividends either by payment or re-investment.
  • Calculating and disbursing payments of fees to the investment manager/advisor, custodian, administrator and other service providers as required.
  • To ensure fund administration services fees are settled by the client on timely manner.
  • Communicate with CPC and other relevant parties on daily operational issue (under appropriate supervision of Senior/Manager) and regular services review.
  • To ensure clear and smooth communication with Fund Accounting Team, Transfer Agency Team, Fund Compliance Team, Custody Team and other operations team for timely updating / maintenance of client records.
  • To support Senior Manager/Head, handle and delivery assigned ad hoc project within the cutoff
  • Manage and avoid risks to clients, Bank/Group by ensuring prompt and accurate reporting to clients/management, timely rectification and /or monitoring of any discrepancies.
  • To provide accurate statistics relating to Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) to help measuring and meet division objectives.
  • To ensure all control/operating procedure and documentations are properly followed.
  • To ensure daily working volumes to be recorded accuracy and timely

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group's business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates

Processes

  • Responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Net Asset Value of the fund in each valuation

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.
