ln:4468730265.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Customer sales and service for PP clients: provide professional, comprehensive, and tailor-made financial services to Priority Private clients at asset allocation and wealth management, keep improving customer satisfaction and stickiness.

职责范围：

  • PP客户的销售与服务：为Priority Private客户提供全面、专业、量身定制的投资及保险规划服务，不断提高高端客户的满意度和客户黏性。

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge, and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies.
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank.
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections.
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Study Portfolio Management Strategy based on customer’s needs and wealth planning concept, provide PP clients with professional, comprehensive, and tailor-made investment and insurance planning services, including saving, investment, education, and retirement, as well as asset allocation and wealth inheritance proposals.
  • Maintain good and warm relationship with PP customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure PP customers’ needs are well met. Continuously improve customer’s satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing portfolio holdings of PP clients; Regularly review customer's asset allocation, and seek matching points between customer needs and banks’ on-shelf products, and assist to complete the application process.
  • Proactively engage with potential Priority Clients and explore their financial and investment needs; achieve performance targets such as client engagement, portfolio planning and revenue targets.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments.
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures.
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry.
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work.
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaints.

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 运用财富规划理念，以客户需求为导向，研究财富管理策略。为PP客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险规划服务，包括保障、储蓄、投资、子女教育、退休计划等，以及资产配置及财富传承方案。
  • 与PP客户保持良好沟通，维护与PP客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足PP客户需求；做好维护与服务跟踪，不断提高客户满意度和客户黏性。
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；定期复盘客户资产配置状况，将客户需求与本公司的金融产品进行匹配，并协助其完成申请流程；
  • 主动发现具有“私人财富”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；全方位达成客户接洽、财富规划和业务指标等各类业绩目标。
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • List all responsibilities associated with the management of stakeholders e.g. regulators, other bank teams

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Investment counselling and analytical skills
  • CFP/AFP/CFA holders

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • Top performer in city ranking, with more than 5 years’ frontline sales experience in banking or financial services industry.
  • No severe conduct case in last 1 year.
  • Solid knowledge of financial products and services, banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services.
  • Candidates with CFP/AFP/CFA, or other certificates related to Wealth Management are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

职位要求：

  • 全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。
  • 所在城市的销售业绩优异者，具有5年以上的银行和金融服务行业的前线销售经验。
  • 近一年内无严重违规记录。
  • 熟悉银行产品、服务、银行程序、股票市场、单位信托以及其它个人投资服务。
  • 持有财富管理类、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，CFA等）者优先考虑。
  • 具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
  • 出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
  • 具有团队意识，主动坚定。
  • 有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。
  • 具备较好的中英文口头及书面沟通能力。

Job Summary

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long-term growth and stability.

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life-stages.
  • Build long-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  • Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  • Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  • Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.

Skills And Experience

  • Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.

Job Summary

  • The role holder will be responsible for the budget volume of CMPS business and therefore to establish an agenda of the top business and plan to address the same.

  • Grow net-new-money to the bank through providing investment advisory focus on CMPS products to NTB & ETB customer.
  • Increase CMPS product penetration rate and Promotion digital platforms for Retail clients.
  • Use the framework of asset allocation to execute the financial plan for each NTB/ETB client to grow NTP number and optimize portfolio look. Responsible for branch sales strategy formulation, sales momentum tracking and business target review on CMPS products.

  • Comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and, in particular, report any suspicious activity to the Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer and line manager.

Job Summary

  • To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
  • To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Perform detailed review of the reports to CPC/clients including: Verification trades to relevant supporting, Ensure valuation of investments being checked to third party sources, Ensure appropriate accounting for complex investment, Ensure compliance with internal investment restrictions, external regulations and international accounting standards, if applicable. Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
  • Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
  • To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
  • To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.
  • To ensure proper and accurate calculation and posting of management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum.
  • Recording and disbursing dividends either by payment or re-investment.
  • Calculating and disbursing payments of fees to the investment manager/advisor, custodian, administrator and other service providers as required.
  • To ensure fund administration services fees are settled by the client on timely manner.
  • Communicate with CPC and other relevant parties on daily operational issue (under appropriate supervision of Senior/Manager) and regular services review.
  • To ensure clear and smooth communication with Fund Accounting Team, Transfer Agency Team, Fund Compliance Team, Custody Team and other operations team for timely updating / maintenance of client records.
  • To support Senior Manager/Head, handle and delivery assigned ad hoc project within the cutoff
  • Manage and avoid risks to clients, Bank/Group by ensuring prompt and accurate reporting to clients/management, timely rectification and /or monitoring of any discrepancies.
  • To provide accurate statistics relating to Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) to help measuring and meet division objectives.
  • To ensure all control/operating procedure and documentations are properly followed.
  • To ensure daily working volumes to be recorded accuracy and timely

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group's business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates

Processes

  • Responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Net Asset Value of the fund in each valuation

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.

Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.

Risk Management

  • The ability to interpret the reconciliation breaks, prices fluctuations, ledger imbalances, valuation checking exception, identify key issues or potential risk based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.

Governance

  • Responsible for complying to the group’s governance requirement, oversight and controls in the business

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Onshore business partner
  • Client
  • Upstream teams ( GRU, CDMG, CS, Settlement, CA)

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China / Fiduciary and Fund Services Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Support group’s operation transformation roadmap.

Skills And Experience

  • Accounting
  • Financial Market
  • Fund Operation
  • MS Office Suite

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Certification in accounting or finance is a plus
  • Languages: English, Mandarin

ln:4470243941.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.
  • This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

  • Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serve more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
  • We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
  • We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

ln:4468799239.descriptionHtml:
Business Functions

As the leading bank in Asia, Transformation & Data (T&D) supports our management on the implementation of the Group’s agenda. Data Chapter, organized under T&D, is committed to create synergies between the data analytics functions across the bank, establish centres of excellence, shared services, and reusable data assets, as well as enhance career opportunities and the sense of community for data professionals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of data professionals delivering actionable analytics to drive the Investment Product & Advisory business targeting the affluent customer segment.
  • Formulate data-driven strategies to accelerate Investment Product penetration and grow overall portfolio revenue.
  • Design and deliver data solutions to drive revenue, enhance productivity, and monitor risk, including cross-sell opportunity and attrition identification, wealth shift analyses, and performance dashboards.
  • Lead and collaborate with regional teams to build and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for the Investment business such as Advisory Co-pilot and Automated Sales Surveillance.
  • Partner with Product Heads and Advisory Sales Heads to align data priorities with overarching business goals.
  • Ensure all data operations, AI models, and regulatory reporting standards strictly comply with the Bank’s governance and risk frameworks.
  • Translate quantitative insights into clear narratives for business executives and senior leaders.
  • Champion the adoption of the latest analytics tools, AI capabilities, and cloud architecture within the consumer analytics ecosystem.


Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.

ln:4470483944.descriptionHtml:
Ready to shape Corporate Sales growth for Strategic and Focus clients?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

Corporate Sales sits within HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) and supports corporate clients with relevant products, solutions and market insight. This role focuses on serving Strategic and Focus clients, building trusted relationships and improving product penetration and wallet share. You’ll manage revenue and profitability across an allocated client portfolio while delivering a high standard of service from idea through to execution and post-trade. The role also has a strong focus on improving the cost of service delivery including shifting transactional activity towards e-capability where appropriate. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll set direction for the local Corporate Sales team and maintain a strong control environment across front office activity. Success means measurable portfolio growth, strong client feedback and consistent delivery in line with HSBC policies and regulatory expectations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a portfolio of Strategic and Focus corporate clients with clear ownership of revenue performance
  • Identify sales opportunities end-to-end from client need through execution and post-trade support
  • Provide day-to-day coverage across the Corporate Sales offering, coordinating with trading teams to support execution flow
  • Develop client relationships that strengthen product penetration and expand share of wallet across priority accounts
  • Partner with Relationship Managers, Global Payments Solutions (GPS) and Global Trade Solutions (GTS) to meet client needs
  • Champion adoption of appropriate service models such as migrating transactional activity to self-service e-capability
  • Coordinate with Corporate Risk Solutions (CRS) for complex balance sheet structuring solutions and cross-sell opportunities
  • Maintain an effective control environment, escalating unusual or unacceptable activity and supporting fair customer outcomes
  • Oversee team activity where supervisory responsibilities apply including performance management, coaching and resource planning
  • Adapt processes as technology platforms evolve while keeping service quality and risk controls front of mind

What We're Looking For

  • Bring strong experience in Corporate Sales including knowledge of products, clients, systems and key processes
  • Apply established understanding of capital markets including foreign exchange instruments and interest rate derivatives
  • Manage transaction flow from order through to execution in partnership with trading teams and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrate a track record of developing client relationships that translate into revenue growth and deeper product usage
  • Partner effectively across teams and regions to deliver coordinated client coverage and consistent service
  • Operate within regulatory requirements for non-advisory sales and trading activities including holding relevant local or cross-border exams and qualifications or equivalent demonstrable experience
  • Apply sound judgement in managing conduct risk, financial crime risk and operational risk within a front office environment
  • Supervise and develop team members where applicable including performance management, coaching and maintaining quality of output

Building deeper Corporate Sales relationships

This role offers the chance to shape how HSBC supports Strategic and Focus corporate clients across products, execution and service models. You’ll be central to improving client outcomes while strengthening revenue performance and operational efficiency. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll also create clarity on standards and controls and support a consistent approach to front office supervision.

If you want your work to be measured in client trust, disciplined execution and sustainable growth this role is a strong platform to build from. Apply to help expand the HSBC Corporate Sales franchise through relationships that last and solutions that land well in market.

We want to hear from you if…

You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 - June 2028)

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking, and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following:

  • Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments
  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills
  • Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry
  • Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making


We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program runs for 10 weeks and begins with initial classroom based training, followed by ongoing training sessions throughout the length of the program, as well as a series of networking and social events. Analysts will complete two rotations across different teams within the Corporate Banking group. Incoming Summer Analysts have the opportunity to be considered for a position on the following year’s full-time Analyst Program.

Your time here will look something like this...

  • Provide advice: this involves working with our clients to develop and execute their strategic objectives. We advise them on a number of areas including whether to buy or sell companies or assets, how to restructure finances, and where and how to invest capital
  • Work with Capital Markets: we work very closely with the Citi CMO team (Capital Markets Origination) to help our clients raise capital in the equity and debt capital markets


You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Summer Interns to join the Corporate Banking team in Asia Pacific. Citi’s Corporate Bank is a leading provider of financial services to top-tier multi-national clients around the globe, serving the financial needs of the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions. The Corporate group advises corporate clients who want to raise funds in capital markets and who need strategic support in financial transactions. Initiatives you may be working on with clients include mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, financial restructurings, underwriting, and distributing equity, debt, and derivative securities. As a Summer Analyst, you will join an intensive ten-week program where you will receive in-depth education on a variety of these topics to learn the fundamentals of the Analyst role and introduce you to Citi’s culture.

We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Job Family

Full time

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Backend architecture & delivery for RAG (incl. Graph RAG & agentic search): Design and implement core RAG backend capabilities, including retrieval, re-ranking, context construction, prompt orchestration, response aggregation, Graph RAG patterns (entity/relation extraction, graph traversal, graph-grounded context assembly), and agentic search (multi-step query planning, iterative retrieval, tool/function calling).
  • Build pipelines for multi-modal and multi-type data (documents, emails, wikis, images, tables, logs, structured sources), including extraction/OCR, chunking, enrichment, embedding, and incremental re-indexing with rollback.
  • Retrieval, ranking & graph reasoning optimisation: Implement hybrid retrieval (BM25/vector/structured filters), multi-stage recall, reranking (cross-encoder/LLM), deduplication/diversity controls, and graph-based retrieval strategies to improve relevance, explainability, and traceability.
  • Grounded, supported answer generation: Build generation workflows that produce grounded answers with explicit support (citations, quoted evidence snippets, and source metadata), including answer structuring, confidence/scoring signals, refusal/insufficient-evidence handling, and traceable “why this answer” outputs for auditability.
  • Security & compliance: Implement access controls (RBAC/ABAC), data classification and masking, audit logging, encryption, and secrets management; ensure retrieval and generation flows meet bank-grade compliance requirements.
  • Data governance & lineage: Enforce data ownership, classification, retention, and access policies; maintain metadata standards, lineage, and provenance (citations/attribution) to ensure outputs are grounded in approved sources.
  • Quality evaluation & continuous improvement: Establish offline/online evaluation (groundedness, faithfulness, citation coverage, latency), enabling A/B testing and regression validation.
  • Cross-team collaboration: Partner with AI Infra, data platforms, information security, and product teams to land RAG capabilities in multiple systems and continuously evolve the platform.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience; strong proficiency in at least one mainstream backend stack: Python (FastAPI) or Go.
  • Solid understanding of core RAG components and patterns, including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, context window management, citations/attribution, and evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience with containerisation and cloud-native engineering (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), with a proven track record of troubleshooting and performance tuning in production.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver under multi-dimensional constraints (security, compliance, performance, and cost).
  • Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

Job Summary

  • To lead and drive a sales team in achieving agreed sales volume and revenue objectives by acquiring, growing, and retaining SME Banking customers within acceptable risk parameters. To contribute towards achieving the region’s overall SME Banking targets.
  • Overall responsible for SME banking business performance, customer experience, people management and governance control for the assigned portfolio.
  • Build a sustainable and scalable SME business.
  • Lead the overall implementation and delivery of business strategy and financial plans for SME banking Team, within regulatory framework and the group’s policies and risk guidelines.
  • Manage sales teams and be responsible for achieving agreed city sales target and revenue objectives.
  • Optimize resource allocation and growth opportunities towards delivering higher return.
  • Build and develop a high-quality sales force via structured training and people development (including conduct culture).
  • In line with the commitment to serve SME segment by supporting their high-quality development needs, SME department will continue to extend the coverage of financial services, uplift comprehensive financial service capabilities for SMEs, as well as provide one-bank financial solution to support SMEs’ whole life cycle growth (from start-up to cross-border expansion).

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Performance

  • Develop and execute business strategy in SME banking segments to achieve the following goals:
  • Financials: Financial objectives by product and by customer, Revenue growth, Cost/Income management, Footings & Market Share growth, etc
  • Customers: Segment Management, Customer – Client centric acquisitions, Client retention management, account activation and usage
  • Manage and optimize SME Banking City portfolio risk versus return
  • Put in place the necessary sales infrastructure to support good quality customer acquisitions and driving productivity gains.
  • Contribute towards establishing the strategy and priorities for the SME banking business in the responsible city portfolios.
  • Consult and recommend strategies where account management or recovery is needed on problem accounts, assisting CMR / GSAM in identifying sources to expedite loan recovery.
  • Deepen relationship with SME Banking customers in providing effective need based financial solution.
  • Generate new business via direct selling to customers and referrals from different approved sales channels.
  • Build and expand existing customer relationships via in depth analysis of their needs.
  • Identify and prioritize activities to maximize revenue contribution from the high potential customers.

Business Management

  • To lead all SME sales teams and to build a sustainable and scalable SME business.
  • Contribute towards developing innovative products, product-cross sells and direct channels based on customer insights to deliver increase market share and financial objectives.
  • Contribute towards developing and managing product lifecycle to optimize portfolio revenues and risk.
  • Help to identify new segments, channels or opportunities for product distribution and marketing.
  • Work with Marketing on product marketing, branding and franchise building.

Process

  • Contribute towards improving the end-to-end process for SME with focus on quality in delivery and cycle time.
  • Manage the productivity and efficiency of the value stream.
  • Give regular feedback to management on product and processes based on customer feedback.
  • Work closely with branch service staff and other SME Banking service centers to ensure a high level of after-sales service is provided to SME Banking customers.

People & Talent

  • Build a strong local talent pipeline for future business growth and continuity.
  • Coach direct reports and key talents to deliver on individual performance.
  • Manage employee engagement, motivation, and attrition issues.
  • Be an effective agent of change and a role model for talented managers throughout the Bank.
  • Identify and develop high potential team members.
  • Identify and manage-out low performing team members.
  • Perform professionally as a team player to lead, co-work, or support in all SME Banking related initiatives.
  • Enhance & multiply the quality & depth of direct reports in SME Banking family.
  • Drive performance through clear objectives via scorecards, KPIs.
  • Identify current and future employee development needs (skills, training, behaviour, coaching, and career path).
  • Identify and recruit new staff based on the staff planning with supports from local HR and HR business partner.

Risk Management

  • Ensure effective and efficient operations without sacrifice on control and service quality. Continually look at opportunities for process improvements.
  • Work effectively across SCB, using values behaviours to drive sustainable business growth.
  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct

Compliance & Control

  • Ensure strict compliance with all regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities by all staff.
  • Contribute towards achieving and maintaining satisfactory audit rating.
  • Contribute towards ensuring that the value stream is fit for growth and have effective controls framework.
  • Fully understand the importance of fraud prevention, prevent fraud risks, maintain safe and steady operation of the position, implement regulatory requirements of fraud prevention, strictly execute DOIs of the department, ensure to complete relevant trainings and embed fraud prevention in daily work.
  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.
  • Failing to pass WRB essential for sales will be considered as assessment basis for job incompetency.
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML CDD/Sanction requirements when performing duties:

ln:4470679902.descriptionHtml:
Commercial Banking (CMB)

HSBC Commercial Banking serves millions of small, medium-sized and middle-market enterprises, providing commercial customers with a full range of banking services including multi-currency business accounts, payments and cash management, wealth management and insurance, and global trade and receivables finance, as well as a comprehensive range of financing solutions. With dedicated Relationship Managers and Business Specialists providing local support and advice in over 60 countries and territories, HSBC helps customers make the most of opportunities for their businesses.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Assist in executing China ecosystem partnership strategies to achieve Business Banking's strategic priorities
  • Assist in partnership engagements, pitches, deal negotiations and related industry analysis to achieve the China partnership strategy in focused sectors
  • Manage partners and internal stakeholders with an agile approach to ensure excellent delivery
  • Coordinate partnership meetings to ensure strategic objectives are achieved and maintained. Mange and nurture excellent relationship with partnerships for long-term collaboration
  • Project management to ensure delivery of projects, POCs, sprint planning, mange partner onboarding and work closely with Customer Intelligence team to deliver projects
  • Responsible for managing partnership risk/ conflict of interests associated with partner selection, contractual relationship and partnership operating model
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders from Global/ Product teams to deliver joint-up propositions
  • Inform on external market trends and current thought leadership, including competitor analysis, identifying potential development opportunities for CMB

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Proven experience in executing strategic partnership opportunities
  • Knowledge of the local Fin-techs/ Banks' digital innovation trend and competition in China
  • Relationship/stakeholder management and influencing skills, excellent interpersonal and communication skills in both mandarin Chinese and English with a proven ability to communicate effectively and confidently at all levels.
  • Commercial banking frontline / Fin-tech working experience in China is an advantage for this role
  • Be curious – Whilst fintech and technology innovation experience is advantageous, an inquisitive and curious mind-set around banking technology and the changing external fintech landscape is a must
  • Demonstrate a focus on execution – components of this role will be new to HSBC and the industry, and a successful candidate will need to influence others with a desire 'to get things done' by key deadlines
  • Project management/ strategy experience is an advantage but not essential

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4470697105.descriptionHtml:
CIB - Corporate Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Contribute to Global Markets sales revenue generation, return targets set by business performance and objectives
  • Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
  • Service a portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus clients, including Transactional clients where required
  • Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
  • Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
  • Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 10 years' relevant experience as a Global Markets corporate sales
  • Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
  • Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in East China will be preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability
  • Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
  • Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names
  • Strong sense of operational risk management and ability to adhere to the Bank's operational risk requirements
  • Attention to detail and ability to ensure that transactions, business information is captured in a timely and highly accurate manner
  • Able to work independently with limited supervision, proactive and willing to run job duties under pressure against multiple deadlines
  • Business Travels will be required

ln:4470694156.descriptionHtml:
HSBC Qianhai

HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.

The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.

By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.

Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.

HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.

We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.

We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.

To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.

Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.

We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.

The role background

As part of the China Technology Research team, the Research Associate will support fundamental equity research across technology sectors through company analysis, financial modelling, industry deep-dive and research publications.

We are looking for a highly curious and analytical research analyst with strong independent judgement, intellectual integrity and a high sense of ownership. The ideal candidate embraces new technologies and research methodologies while maintaining rigorous thinking, professional ethics and high standards of compliance.

Experiences of investment research (Sell or Buy side), strategy & accounting, consulting might be preferred.

Responsibilities Of The Role Holder

  • Fundamental Research

Conduct company and industry research, build and maintain financial models and analytical frameworks, analyse business fundamentals and competitive dynamics, and contribute to high-quality research publications in both English and Chinese.

  • Research Excellence

Leverage data, technology and modern research tools to improve productivity and deepen analysis. Evaluate information critically, verify sources independently, and translate complex problems into clear, evidence-based investment insights.

  • Analytical Thinking

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Manager.

Principal responsibilities

The jobholder will be a member of the Business Analytics within Business Finance and Reporting team, providing management information and analytical support to the Global Head of Business Finance and Reporting. Key activities include the preparation of business management papers, reviewing and challenging external reporting results including forecast projections, and driving transformation initiatives around the financial planning processes, among others

  • Reporting Review: Support the review and challenge of the IFRS 17 results, including participation in governance forums to provide Group advice and challenges to financial analysis and management actions.
  • Forecasting Analytics: Support the analysis, interpretation, and development of solutions for Management Information to provide business insights and implications, including but not limited to budgeting and forecasting.
  • Result Communication and Consolidation: Fully understand the IFRS 17 reporting results from local entities and support the formulation of a Group ‘story’ around the numbers. Assist in the preparation of Group management information packs summarizing actuarial reporting results and project outcomes for various stakeholders.
  • Methodology and Basis Review: Support the review and challenge of the reasonableness of actuarial approaches, methodologies, assumptions, simplifications, and any actuarial judgments applied in IFRS 17 reporting to ensure compliance with the underlying IFRS 17 policies, controls, and risk framework, including participation in basis review committees.
  • Stay Informed: Keep abreast of developments and changes in accounting policies, methodologies, and processes to support an early assessment of IFRS 17 results impacts, strengthen SOX controls, and improve documentation around the production process.
  • Market Awareness: Stay informed about market practices, new topics discussed by industry discussion groups, and/or market surveys/statistics conducted by consultants and regulatory bodies.

Requirements

  • Experienced, qualified actuary with recognised professional body (e.g. IFoA, SOA).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in financial reporting, with a proven track record within life insurance companies or consultancy firms,
  • Strong actuarial knowledge of IFRS17, familiar with the end-to-end reporting methodology, assumption, process, control and governance.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with expertise in presenting and producing high quality reports at governance forums.
  • Experience prophet modelling and/or understanding to finance system and accounting rule is an advantage.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Job Summary

A highly skilled and experienced for Wealth Solutions Operations (i.e WSO), with deep knowledge and experience in managing fund operations, structured deposits and other WS related financial derivative products. This role requires a responsible and detail-oriented professional with experience in operational project management, supporting business strategy development and effectively managing operational risks and controls in WSO team. Support LM and team take the ownership and deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support LM to achieve and deliver strategy and outcomes on standard metrics/scorecard.
  • Support LM and lead team to drive transformation of WS operation teams to align with WRB Client Journeys in the market. Oversee the innovation and continuous improvement projects relating to WS ops and be responsible for outcomes with related business stakeholders and 2nd lines.
  • Support LM and lead team to develop and sustain a compliance culture, ensure flawless execution and compliance to timely identify and address arising risks and control gaps if any, develop effective communication and supervise training to promote risk awareness and compliance culture, collaborate with business partners, cross-functions teams to ensure a coherent, seamless delivery and strong governance foundation built within team.
  • Engage key stakeholders and within the broader business partners to ensure alignment across governance/control/conduct agendas.

Processes

  • Lead and oversee WSO related policies and processes and being responsible to design, manage and implement end-to-end related policies, processes to ensure that relevant policies, procedure, and standards are effectively implemented across Wealth Products Operations and ensure effectiveness control design and governance oversights and assurance of processes and frameworks for robust compliance, as well as take the ownership to lead and drive the WSO governance across product lines.
  • Drive and deliver WS products sales process simplification and Project implementation by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Lead and oversee WS ops related platform to support WS digitization journey and initiatives delivery and ensuring the effectiveness of related project delivery in a coherent and seamless way and the consistency of functionality and control design across the platforms including offline sales channels, that with related project post implementation review can ensure the effectiveness of functionality and control design being accordance with internal and external standard as well as should manage associate incident risk assessment if applicable that can always put a robust compliance and control against internal and external requirements.
  • Lead and drive to identify and achieve WSO operations excellence and efficiency to be aligned with country, business, function strategy goals.

People & Talent

  • Provide strategic thought leadership, coaching, recognition and motivation through positive reinforcements and frequent feedback sessions.
  • Promote risk awareness and compliance culture. Lead through example and build the appropriate Conduct culture and values.
  • Strengthen the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities.
  • Ensure team members are suitably trained/skilled for the job and fit for growth.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Identify talented individuals and provide stretch opportunities for career development.

Risk Management

  • Reinforce the risk management, conduct and governance discipline, and driving alignment/streamlining of key sales and operation processes by by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Support the WS Head to deliver the business priorities through continuously improving on process productivity and efficiency, meeting regulatory and internal policy requirements and driving a standardization agenda for the business as well as representation at the relevant risk/conduct/governance committees and forums by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Translate strategy, policy, themes, into actionable plans which are realistic within WS business and regulatory context. See plans through the execution phase by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Lead and drive WSO data management framework implementation quality in function, manages data quality improvement project and new data elements collection from product/ other biz & regulatory requirements, and accountable for functional data leverage in business revenue driven/ risk monitoring/ processing automation. In addition, can provide support to LM and team to take the ownership and deliver the task/agenda according to the objective pre-set.

Governance

  • Ensure Satisfactory Audit Outcomes by working with WS process owners and related stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards as defined by internal and external requirements as well as ensure that identified risks are subject to appropriate remedial action, escalated to the relevant senior committee if required and followed through to closure by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders
  • Engage with key stakeholders to ensure alignment across governance / control / conduct agendas for WS more broadly.
  • Taking responsibility for data management framework implementation quality in function by working with WS process owners to manages data quality improvement project and new data elements collection from product/ other biz & regulatory requirements, and accountable for functional data leverage in business revenue driven/ risk monitoring/ processing automation

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Establish and implement a stable and reliable world class operating sales platform and control environment by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders.
  • By working with WS process owners and related stakeholders, oversee Implementation of risk management, working with WRB BRM/related risk function team to guide business risk management to ensure full implementation of ORF across the business unit. Ensure execution of the first line self-assessment model, report on and analyse operational risks profile. Track and follow through management actions to mitigate identified operational risks exposure.
  • Actively manage and remediate any breaches and deviations from global / local standards by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders
  • Ensure full reporting of losses, risk events, policy deviations, KCST & KRI exception, and engage appropriate stakeholders on timely remedial actions; escalate key risk situations that pose significant risks by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders.
  • Identify new, thematic, and developing risks; provide operational risk advice through various reviews including but not limited to accountability reviews, Lessons Learnt reviews, Process / Control reviews, Peer review) at the unit level by working with WS process owners, WRB BRM and related stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify key risks through Country Conduct Plan and Conduct Heatmap where application by working with related conduct team, WS/related process owner.

  • Fully understand the importance of consumer rights protection, prevent damage to consumer’s best interest, implement regulatory requirements related to consumer rights protection, ensure to complete relevant trainings and to always embed consumer rights protection mindset when performing daily work.

  • Group CFCC, Legal and OR teams
  • Group Wealth Products teams
  • Group Wealth COO office

  • Project Management
  • Data Governance
  • PRT risk management
  • Conduct Management
  • Wealth Product Knowledge
  • Wealth Operations

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above
  • Training: Data soft skills if any
  • Licenses: With CMF certification
  • Membership: No specific requirement
  • Certifications: With CMF certification

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Work in PCVC team to manage the Product control activities for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Support Team Head to establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

Skills and Experience

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness
  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
  • CICPA & CFA is preferred
  • Languages: Chinese and English

Company Profile

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm’s employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

Morgan Stanley Investment Management China (MSIM China) provides diverse investment management services to a full spectrum of clients across both individual and institutional investors. Established as a joint venture in 2008, MSIM China became fully owned by Morgan Stanley Investment Management in 2023.

Department Profile

Global Financial Crimes (GFC) coordinates day-to-day implementation of the Firm’s enterprise-wide financial crime prevention efforts. GFC includes both legal and compliance disciplines and has responsibility for governance, oversight and execution of the Firm’s Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Anti-Corruption, Anti-Tax Evasion and Government and Political Activities Compliance programs. GFC also develops and/or assists in the development of appropriate policies and procedures, including those designed to assist the business units to know their clients and conduct appropriate due diligence and to prevent, detect and report potentially suspicious activity.

The Firm is currently seeking a driven and experienced professional to cover MSIM China GFC. This role is based in Shenzhen, China.

What You’ll Do In The Role

  • Participate in building the fixed income investment research system, refine research frameworks, databases, and quantitative pricing models, and track research and investment opportunities in innovative bond products and new directions for fund instruments. Provide implementation coverage for the Firm’s AML/CFT program in support of global deliverables and regional priorities in MSIM China;
  • Assist the APAC Head of MSIM GFC and MSIM China CCO to drive implementation of AML programs and enhancements through analysis, prioritization of implementation phases based on system dependencies, risk based analysis and regulatory considerations;
  • Monitoring of local regulatory developments and new rules or requirements;
  • Drafting and implementing appropriate AML policies and procedures;
  • Advise on, and resolve, potential AML issues and internal enquiries arising from business units of MSIM China;
  • Assisting to liaise with AML system vendors to implement changes and conduct systems testing in conjunction with stakeholders;
  • Assist with responding to regulatory exams and other inquiries, and internal audits, including overseeing document production and data collection in connection with these enquiries;
  • Supervision of know-your customer and client due diligence processes including assessing the Financial Crime risk associated with potential and existing high-risk clients;
  • Investigation and escalation of ongoing monitoring alerts and queries;
  • Oversight and supervision of the filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR);
  • Reviewing, validating, and providing advice to action owners on matters relating to Anti-Corruption & Bribery and Gift & Entertainment, covering sales, marketing event and expense management processes;
  • Facilitating communication and clarification of standards in relation to sanctions, AML, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, and Gift & Entertainment with regional Financial Crimes and Compliance teams.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • Bachelor's degree;
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in AML Compliance or regulatory compliance work, preferably in a financial services environment or audit consulting capacity with strong knowledge of the China regulatory environment;
  • An analytical mindset with attention to detail;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin;
  • Ability to independently interact with senior business management;
  • Strong team player and ability to operate in an international environment;
  • Certification as an Anti-Money Laundering Specialist by ACAMS or equivalent AML certification/license - or certification within 15 months of hire.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
